chapters.title: Chapter 151: Celeste Flamoir is Ambushed, Meeting the Imperial Guild
paragraphs: Leon decided to stay out of the [Divine Academy]’s way for now.
Even though they were connected to the gods, their levels and combat power were simply too high for him to deal with directly.
There was no reason to rush into danger when he could gain more information first.
Instead, Leon wanted to explore the place a little before the event started.
The city surrounding the academy was enormous, and he had just arrived.
It would be a waste not to look around and understand the environment he could be fighting in.
So Leon spent the next hour simply walking through [Divine Academy City].
The place was massive. It wasn’t on the same level as [Myriad Race City], which had been built to host countless races from across the [Lower Domains].
But it was still large enough to hold tens of thousands of players comfortably.
Buildings stretched far in every direction. Large stone roads connected the various districts, and players from different worlds walked around everywhere.
’It really feels strange to see that.’
In Leon’s past life, things had been very different.
By the time he reached his own domain, he would have already entered the [Warrior Tower], fighting through the early floors and struggling to survive like everyone else.
He would never have imagined himself walking through a city in a different [Higher Domain].
But now everything had changed. His path was completely different from before.
And the more Leon thought about it, the more interesting it became.
Somewhere else in the vast world of [Eternal Ascension], other players were probably going through their own challenges.
After all, [Higher Domain #1] was the only domain that had this academy system.
All the other [Higher Domains] had completely different structures.
Each domain functioned differently, offering unique paths for the players inside them.
The scale of [Eternal Ascension] was simply too large to fully comprehend.
Still, after exploring the city for a while, Leon eventually felt satisfied.
He had already seen most of the important areas near the academy district, and nothing particularly unusual had happened during his walk.
So he found a quiet place nearby and sat down on a stone bench.
Once seated, he closed his eyes and began focusing.
’Right now, my main priority is to get stronger, finding the servants of the gods and...’
Leon slowly turned his gaze toward another floating panel in front of him.
’Hatch that thing.’
[Primordial Dragon of Chaos (Unhatched)]
[Rank: Divine]
[Hatching Time: 4,228 years, 326 days.]
Leon stared at the panel silently.
The number had gone down. But only by one day.
That meant the timer was functioning normally, decreasing with time.
However, the problem was obvious. Four thousand years.
That amount of time would never pass if he did it the "normal" way.
Which meant one thing: the egg was never meant to hatch naturally.
There had to be another method. Something that could drastically reduce the hatching time.
Unfortunately, Leon still had no clear idea what that method could be.
His best option right now was a skill he possessed: [Divine Answer].
That skill allowed him to receive a perfect answer to any question.
If he used it and asked how to hatch the [Primordial Dragon of Chaos], the [Heavenly One] would almost certainly provide the correct method.
It would guarantee success. But Leon hesitated. He only had three uses.
Three chances to receive answers that could completely change his future.
Using one of those precious opportunities on the dragon egg felt... wasteful. At least for now.
Not until he was absolutely certain there was no other way to figure it out.
’I’ll leave it for later.’
Leon closed the panel.
Once he finished reviewing everything, he stood up from the bench and stretched slightly.
Then he took a deep breath. It was time to move again.
Instead of staying inside the city, Leon decided to head outside of [Divine Academy City].
There were still two hours before the event began, and wasting that time sitting around would accomplish nothing.
He could at least scout the surrounding areas.
But just as Leon began walking toward the exit of the city...
Ding!
[There are only 2 hours left before the next "event".]
Leon rolled his eyes slightly.
’Yeah, yeah, I know.’
He continued walking. Soon, he reached the main square near the city’s exit.
The square was large and open, filled with players passing through as they entered or left the city.
But just as Leon stepped into the area...
BOOM!
A sudden explosion erupted in the middle of the square.
The loud noise immediately caught everyone’s attention.
Leon’s eyes narrowed as he instinctively prepared himself.
There were no guards inside this city. That meant players were free to fight each other.
And whenever a fight broke out in a place like this, things could escalate quickly.
Leon calmly moved closer to the source of the commotion. Voices soon reached his ears.
"Are you people stupid? It’s a goddamn phoenix, just kill her!"
"She’s strong though..."
The crowd ahead of him shifted as several players backed away from the center of the square.
Leon pushed forward slightly until he finally gained a clear view of the situation.
The moment he saw what was happening, his eyes widened slightly.
’Oh shit.’
Standing in the center of the square was a semi-familiar figure: Celeste Flamoir.
The phoenix-race girl he had previously seen inside the [Intermediate Divine Temple].
She was currently facing around a dozen opponents. All of them surrounded her from every direction.
It was surprising to see her here.
The fact that she had also reached [Higher Domain #1] meant she had progressed through the earlier domain extremely quickly.
But right now, she was clearly in trouble.
"The [Imperial Guild] simply wants to recruit you," a tall man said with a grin.
Leon focused on the speaker. The man had long hair and a noticeable scar across his face.
His presence alone made it clear he was the leader of the group.
"You could become a very important... asset to us."
Leon immediately understood the situation.
Like many powerful organizations, the [Imperial Guild] had likely learned about the phoenix race.
And the phoenix race possessed one of the most terrifying abilities in [Eternal Ascension]: rebirth.
As long as a phoenix died, they would eventually revive again.
That ability alone made them extremely valuable allies. Or extremely dangerous enemies.1
Celeste glared at the group surrounding her, her eyes filled with anger.
"I would rather die than join you all."
Power began gathering around her body. Flames slowly ignited along her spear.
But the moment she said those words... The leader’s smile disappeared.
"So be it," he said coldly. Then he raised his hand, "Capture her."
His voice became sharper.
"And alive. If she dies she’ll just revive."
Immediately, the members of the group began drawing their weapons as they moved closer to Celeste.
The circle tightened. Their intentions were obvious.
On the other hand...
Fwoosh!
Celeste took her stance.
Her spear ignited with blazing fire, the aura around her growing stronger.
She was ready to fight. But Leon could already guess her real plan.
If the situation became hopeless, she would simply kill herself.
As a phoenix, death was not the end. It was escape.
As long as she revived somewhere else, she could permanently evade them.
But that only worked if she died before being captured.
If they restrained her first... Then it would truly be over.
Leon silently activated [Appraisal].1
Fwoosh!
[Name: Celeste Flamoir]
[ID: UndyingPhoenix]
[Level: 52]
[World: Undying (High-Level)]
[Talent: ???]
[Skills: ???]
[Combat Power: ???]
[Details: An individual from the extremely rare "Phoenix" race.]
Then Leon turned his gaze toward the leader.
[Name: Alexander Imperos]
[ID: ImperialMight]
[Level: 64]
[World: Alves (Intermediate-Level World)]
[Talent: ???]
[Skills: ???]
[Combat Power: ???]
[Details: Leader of the rising "Imperial Guild"]
"Hm."
Leon recognized the name immediately.
In his past life, the [Imperial Guild] had eventually become one of the most powerful organizations across the entire [Higher Domains].
Their members were everywhere. Tens of thousands of them.
They had branches in nearly every higher domain.
And their leader... Alexander Imperos.
He was known as a ruthless individual who cared about nothing except power and expansion.
Interestingly enough, he was also human.
Earth was not the only world that produced humans.
Several other worlds also had human populations, some of them far stronger than Earth’s.
Leon couldn’t see the exact [Combat Power] values of either side, but one thing was clear.
The level difference between them was massive.
Celeste was Level 52. Alexander was Level 64.
That gap alone made things extremely dangerous.
Their actual combat strength might not be that far apart due to racial advantages and talents... But Alexander still held the advantage.
"Deal with her," Alexander ordered calmly, "I’ll assist if she tries anything."
Celeste’s expression tightened. She clearly understood the situation.
And instead of attacking...
Fwoosh!
She suddenly turned her spear toward her own neck.
She intended to kill herself immediately.
"DON’T LET HER!" Alexander shouted.
At that exact moment—
Fwoosh!
A powerful arrow shot through the air.
CLANG!
The arrow struck Celeste’s spear and knocked it out of her hands, sending it flying across the square.
Her weapon slid across the stone floor and stopped several meters away.
Celeste was now unarmed.

chapters.title: Chapter 152: Fighting the Imperial Guild, Saving Celeste
paragraphs: Alexander laughed after seeing Celeste standing there without a weapon.
The sound carried confidence and amusement, as if the situation had already been decided long before this moment even happened.
"Good job, Karin."
His gaze shifted toward the woman standing behind several members of the group, calmly holding a bow that was still faintly glowing from the shot she had just fired.
"No wonder you’re my co-leader."
Leon immediately recognized her.
Karin. The co-leader of the [Imperial Guild].
Just like Alexander, she had built a reputation for being ruthless, someone who never hesitated when it came to doing whatever was necessary to gain an advantage.
But now the situation had completely shifted. Celeste had no weapon.
And more importantly, she had no allies nearby who were willing to step forward to help her.
From an outside perspective, the outcome already seemed obvious.
A single girl surrounded by multiple high-level players belonging to one of the most powerful guilds currently active in the area was not a scenario that ended well for the person standing alone.
To everyone watching, Celeste looked completely trapped.
Leon observed everything quietly from where he stood.
His eyes moved between Alexander, Karin, and the rest of the surrounding guild members while he considered the situation.
’Did it also end like this in my past life?’ he wondered silently.
Back then, at this exact point in time, he had still been stuck inside the [Novice Village].

He and the rest of his teammates had been dealing with the consequences of the [Challenge Tokens] event, a punishment that had reduced their experience gain and resource acquisition by half for six long hours.
Because of that penalty, they had been forced to remain in the beginner area much longer than other players, struggling to keep up while everyone else moved forward.
This time, however, things had turned out very differently.
Since Leon had managed to win that challenge, his early strength had increased far sooner than it ever had before, allowing him to move through the early stages of the game at an accelerated pace.
That was exactly why he had already reached the [Higher Domain].
Which also meant that something important had changed.
While he had been struggling against beginner monsters inside the village during his previous life... Celeste had most likely been captured here during that exact same time.
If that was the case, then it explained why he had never heard anything about her later.
A phoenix-race player disappearing without leaving any trace would only make sense if her story had ended before it even had the chance to truly begin.
Leon slowly looked around at the players gathered nearby.
Many of them had clearly noticed what was happening.
But none of them stepped forward. None of them even attempted to intervene.
They simply stayed at a distance, pretending to watch something else while keeping careful track of the situation from the corner of their eyes.
The [Imperial Guild] had power, influence, and numbers.
No one wanted to turn them into an enemy.
Leon slowly tightened his grip around the staff in his hand.
’This is just like with Emilia.’ His eyes sharpened, ’I’m not going to stand here and watch them do whatever they want.’
Leon adjusted his grip on both his sword and his staff before stepping forward.
At almost the same moment—
Fwoosh!
Alexander suddenly advanced with a powerful step, clearly deciding that the time for talking had ended.
His sword swung forward with tremendous force as he aimed directly at Celeste.
His goal was not to kill her.
Instead, he intended to cut off one of her limbs, either an arm or a leg, making sure she would no longer be capable of resisting.
Once she was immobilized, capturing her would become extremely easy.
And after they had captured her...
There were countless ways someone from the phoenix race could be exploited.
But just as his blade was about to reach her—
Clang!
Another sword intercepted the strike. Leon stood directly in front of Celeste.
His weapon had perfectly blocked Alexander’s attack, the impact ringing loudly as the two blades collided.
Because of the [Blood Heart Blessing] on Leon’s sword, the force behind his defense was far stronger than Alexander expected.
Even though Alexander was fourteen levels higher, Leon’s raw strength at that moment still surpassed his.
The clash forced Alexander’s blade away.
Leon remained steady. Alexander was not a weak opponent.
But that didn’t change Leon’s decision.
’I can always revive anyway.’
The [Life Vessel] title had changed the way Leon approached danger.
Knowing he possessed the ability to come back to life meant that the risks he took could be higher than before.
And in this situation, saving Celeste from the fate that clearly awaited her felt like a decision worth making.
"Who are you?" Alexander demanded, anger already visible in his eyes. "Why are you intervening?"
Leon did not respond. Instead, he simply raised his sword slightly and prepared himself.
Behind him, Celeste stood in stunned silence. Her eyes were widened slightly in disbelief.

Only moments earlier she had believed that everything was over, that she would be captured and used just like so many others of her kind before her, losing the chance to take revenge or accomplish anything she had set out to do.
Yet now, the same human she had encountered earlier inside the [Intermediate Divine Temple] was standing in front of her again.
’I felt something the first time...’ she thought quietly. Her thoughts moved faster, ’Is this what they call fate?’
Almost immediately she shook her head, pushing the idea away as she forced herself to stand properly again.
"KILL THE HUMAN! CAPTURE THE PHOENIX!"
Alexander’s shout echoed through the area as his aura surged outward.
"Yes, boss!"
The remaining members of the [Imperial Guild] rushed forward without hesitation.
Their levels ranged between 56 and 63, making them players that most others would hesitate to challenge.
But when compared to Leon... They were insignificant.
With a single swing of his sword he cut through three of them instantly, the attack so fast that they died before they even realized what had happened.
The rest of the group froze in shock for a brief moment, but Leon gave them no time to recover.
He raised his staff.
Powerful Fireball!
Flames gathered rapidly at the tip of the weapon, forming a blazing sphere that continued expanding as heat radiated outward.
Leon launched it directly into the approaching group.
"DODGE!" Alexander shouted immediately while retreating toward Karin.
A protective barrier appeared around the two of them just in time.
But the rest of their guild members had no such protection.
The fireball exploded violently.
Flames erupted across the ground, scorching everything in their path and killing the majority of the remaining players almost instantly.
Smoke and heat filled the area.
And then—
SWOOSH!
A sharp sound cut through the air. Karin had already fired another arrow.
This one was far stronger than the previous shot, infused with powerful aura energy as it shot forward with incredible speed.
If that arrow had been aimed at Celeste earlier, it would have killed her instantly.
But Leon reacted immediately.
He swung his sword upward, striking the arrow while it was still midair and cutting it cleanly in half before it could reach him.
Karin’s jaw dropped slightly. Even Alexander looked confused.
Just who was this human? Why was he so strong? And why was he protecting a phoenix-race girl?
"I get it," Alexander suddenly said while laughing as he stepped forward again. "You want her for yourself, don’t you? But wait a second, we’re both human. We can help each other out."
Leon stared at him with an expression so blank it almost looked like he hadn’t heard the words at all.
Alexander genuinely believed Leon had done all this for the same reason he had.
In his mind the solution was obvious: recruit him.
A player this strong joining the [Imperial Guild] would only make them even more powerful.
Who cared about the players Leon had just killed? They were weak members anyway. Completely expendable.
Leon briefly turned his head and looked toward Celeste.
She was trembling slightly.
And at that moment... Leon had already made his decision.
’...Alright.’
ABYSSAL SLASH!
His body vanished into the shadows.
Alexander and Karin both looked around instantly, trying to locate him.
But before either of them could react—
Leon appeared behind Karin.
His sword moved once, and her head separated from her body instantly.
Alexander spun around, his eyes filled with shock as he rushed forward.
"POWER UP!" he shouted as energy surged through his body.
His strength rose to its peak as he swung his sword with everything he had, aiming to crush Leon completely.
Leon raised his own blade. The two weapons collided.
And the result was immediate: Alexander’s sword shattered.
The impact alone sent him flying backward, his body crashing into a nearby shop before slamming against the ground.
Pain spread through his entire body as blood ran down his armor.
When he looked up again, Leon was already standing above him, his figure darkened slightly by the shadow cast from the building behind him while his eyes glowed faintly as he stared down.
Alexander studied him for a moment before speaking.
"You aren’t human... are you?"
Leon remained silent. Alexander slowly nodded.
"That was a good attempt," he said calmly. "But unfortunately for you... killing me or Karin won’t be the end for us."
At that moment Leon understood: they had [Resurrection Stones].
Even if he killed them here, they would revive later.
And when they did, they would return with even more hatred.
Alexander’s eyes burned with fury.
"I’ll make sure you regret ever being born," he roared. "I will—"
Leon didn’t let him finish. His sword moved.
SLASH!
Alexander’s head rolled across the ground. Leon looked down at the corpse calmly.
’Even if you come back...’ His grip tightened slightly around his sword, ’I’ll just be waiting, still stronger than you are.’

His weapon had perfectly blocked Alexander’s attack, the impact ringing loudly as the two blades collided.
Because of the [Blood Heart Blessing] on Leon’s sword, the force behind his defense was far stronger than Alexander expected.
Even though Alexander was fourteen levels higher, Leon’s raw strength at that moment still surpassed his.
The clash forced Alexander’s blade away.
Leon remained steady.
Alexander was not a weak opponent.
But that didn’t change Leon’s decision.
’I can always revive anyway.’
The [Life Vessel] title had changed the way Leon approached danger.
Knowing he possessed the ability to come back to life meant that the risks he took could be higher than before.
And in this situation, saving Celeste from the fate that clearly awaited her felt like a decision worth making.
"Who are you?" Alexander demanded, anger already visible in his eyes.
"Why are you intervening?"
Leon did not respond.
Instead, he simply raised his sword slightly and prepared himself.
Behind him, Celeste stood in stunned silence.
Her eyes were widened slightly in disbelief.

Only moments earlier she had believed that everything was over, that she would be captured and used just like so many others of her kind before her, losing the chance to take revenge or accomplish anything she had set out to do.
Yet now, the same human she had encountered earlier inside the [Intermediate Divine Temple] was standing in front of her again.
’I felt something the first time...’ she thought quietly.
Her thoughts moved faster, ’Is this what they call fate?’
Almost immediately she shook her head, pushing the idea away as she forced herself to stand properly again.
"KILL THE HUMAN!
CAPTURE THE PHOENIX!"
Alexander’s shout echoed through the area as his aura surged outward.
"Yes, boss!"
The remaining members of the [Imperial Guild] rushed forward without hesitation.
Their levels ranged between 56 and 63, making them players that most others would hesitate to challenge.
But when compared to Leon...
They were insignificant.
With a single swing of his sword he cut through three of them instantly, the attack so fast that they died before they even realized what had happened.
The rest of the group froze in shock for a brief moment, but Leon gave them no time to recover.
He raised his staff.
Powerful Fireball!
Flames gathered rapidly at the tip of the weapon, forming a blazing sphere that continued expanding as heat radiated outward.
Leon launched it directly into the approaching group.
"DODGE!" Alexander shouted immediately while retreating toward Karin.
A protective barrier appeared around the two of them just in time.
But the rest of their guild members had no such protection.
The fireball exploded violently.
Flames erupted across the ground, scorching everything in their path and killing the majority of the remaining players almost instantly.
Smoke and heat filled the area.
And then—
SWOOSH!
A sharp sound cut through the air.
Karin had already fired another arrow.
This one was far stronger than the previous shot, infused with powerful aura energy as it shot forward with incredible speed.
If that arrow had been aimed at Celeste earlier, it would have killed her instantly.
But Leon reacted immediately.
He swung his sword upward, striking the arrow while it was still midair and cutting it cleanly in half before it could reach him.
Karin’s jaw dropped slightly.
Even Alexander looked confused.
Just who was this human?
Why was he so strong?
And why was he protecting a phoenix-race girl?
"I get it," Alexander suddenly said while laughing as he stepped forward again.
"You want her for yourself, don’t you?
But wait a second, we’re both human.
We can help each other out."
Leon stared at him with an expression so blank it almost looked like he hadn’t heard the words at all.
Alexander genuinely believed Leon had done all this for the same reason he had.
In his mind the solution was obvious: recruit him.
A player this strong joining the [Imperial Guild] would only make them even more powerful.
Who cared about the players Leon had just killed?
They were weak members anyway.
Completely expendable.
Leon briefly turned his head and looked toward Celeste.
She was trembling slightly.
And at that moment...
Leon had already made his decision.
’...Alright.’
ABYSSAL SLASH!
His body vanished into the shadows.
Alexander and Karin both looked around instantly, trying to locate him.
But before either of them could react—
Leon appeared behind Karin.
His sword moved once, and her head separated from her body instantly.
Alexander spun around, his eyes filled with shock as he rushed forward.
"POWER UP!" he shouted as energy surged through his body.
His strength rose to its peak as he swung his sword with everything he had, aiming to crush Leon completely.
Leon raised his own blade.
The two weapons collided.
And the result was immediate: Alexander’s sword shattered.
The impact alone sent him flying backward, his body crashing into a nearby shop before slamming against the ground.
Pain spread through his entire body as blood ran down his armor.
When he looked up again, Leon was already standing above him, his figure darkened slightly by the shadow cast from the building behind him while his eyes glowed faintly as he stared down.
Alexander studied him for a moment before speaking.
"You aren’t human... are you?"
Leon remained silent.
Alexander slowly nodded.
"That was a good attempt," he said calmly.
"But unfortunately for you... killing me or Karin won’t be the end for us."
At that moment Leon understood: they had [Resurrection Stones].
Even if he killed them here, they would revive later.
And when they did, they would return with even more hatred.
Alexander’s eyes burned with fury.
"I’ll make sure you regret ever being born," he roared.
"I will—"
Leon didn’t let him finish.
His sword moved.
SLASH!
Alexander’s head rolled across the ground.
Leon looked down at the corpse calmly.
’Even if you come back...’ His grip tightened slightly around his sword, ’I’ll just be waiting, still stronger than you are.’

chapters.title: Chapter 153: They Had Resurrection Stones?
paragraphs: After being killed by Leon, the bodies of Karin and Alexander did not remain on the ground like the rest of the fallen members of the [Imperial Guild].
Instead, something entirely different happened.
The two leaders suddenly began to dissolve into small glowing particles.
Their bodies broke apart piece by piece, the fragments lifting into the air before disappearing completely.
Fwoosh! Ding!
[You have automatically consumed a "Resurrection Stone" to revive yourself.]
The notification echoed in their minds at the same time.
Both Karin and Alexander abruptly opened their eyes.
But the scenery around them had completely changed.
Instead of the streets of [Divine Academy City], the two of them now stood inside a massive dark plaza surrounded by twisted buildings and towering statues that radiated a faint, ominous energy.
The sky above was permanently tinted with a crimson glow, and strange lanterns filled with violet flames floated across the streets.
They had returned to the [City of Corruption].
Alexander slowly pushed himself up from the ground while stretching his shoulders slightly, letting out a long sigh as he looked around the familiar environment.
"Looks like we’re back in the [City of Corruption]."
Karin also stood up beside him, brushing off the dust from her clothes while her expression remained unusually serious.
Her mind was still replaying the events from moments earlier.

"This human was... very strong," she finally said quietly, the memory of Leon cutting her arrow in half and appearing behind her before she could react still fresh in her thoughts. "It won’t be easy to beat him."
Alexander remained silent for a brief moment before suddenly laughing.

"It’ll be fine," he said with a grin, clearly far less concerned than his co-leader. "He caught us off guard, that’s all. If we fight him again while prepared, things will be different. And besides... from here on, we’ll be able to grow even stronger."
Karin looked at him carefully.
She had worked with Alexander long enough to know that tone meant he had already started planning something.
"And perhaps..." Alexander continued slowly, the grin on his face widening slightly as his eyes flashed with a dangerous glint, "we might even ask forTHEIRhelp."
The moment Karin heard those words, her expression changed instantly.
Her eyes widened with shock.
"Are you serious?" she asked quickly. "The price we’d have to pay for that kind of help would be—"
"I saw his ID."
Alexander’s sudden interruption made her stop mid-sentence.
Karin tilted her head slightly in confusion.
"You saw it?" she asked.
Alexander nodded slowly, "It’s [Celestial]."
For a brief moment, Karin simply stared at him.
Then realization struck. Her eyes widened even further.
They had both seen the global announcement earlier.

The message that had echoed across the entire world of the [Higher Domains], informing every single player that someone had successfully completed the [God-Rank] assessment inside the [Advanced Divine Temple].

"I didn’t say anything earlier because I didn’t want to attract attention," Alexander continued calmly, crossing his arms while the corners of his mouth curled upward into a cunning smile. "But now that I know who he is... that changes everything."
Karin remained silent as she processed the information.

"Someone like him cannot be allowed to grow freely," Alexander continued. "A player capable of clearing a [God-Rank] assessment this early will eventually become a monster beyond control if we let him live."
His eyes gleamed with cold determination.
"So we’ll do everything in our power to kill him."
Karin slowly nodded.
"...Alright."
Even though the situation was dangerous, the logic behind Alexander’s decision made sense.
"But before that," she added, "we’ll need to find more [Resurrection Stones]. Those two we used were the last ones we had."
Alexander simply laughed again.
"We’ll be fine," he said confidently. "This is only the beginning."
Meanwhile, back in [Divine Academy City].
Leon stood quietly as he watched the bodies of Karin and Alexander dissolve into particles before disappearing completely.
He had already expected something like that.
"At least we’re fine for now," Leon said as he turned his head slightly toward Celeste.
She was still standing behind him.
Although the immediate danger had passed, her body was trembling slightly, the adrenaline from everything that had just happened clearly not fading yet.
Ding!
[Your "Slaughter Meter" has increased by 17.]
[You have taken 5% of all the players’ Eternal Coins, gaining 28,374 Eternal Coins in the process.]
Leon glanced at the notification panels that appeared before him.
"Quite surprised they didn’t have more," he muttered quietly, "They probably stored most of it somewhere else."
His attention shifted to another panel.
Inside his [Storage Space], a total of fifty-one new items had appeared.
Most of them were weapons or armor pieces dropped by the members of the [Imperial Guild] he had just killed.
Unfortunately, almost none of them were useful to him.
After scanning through the list quickly, Leon only found a single item worth keeping: [Strength Potion].
Everything else was mediocre equipment.
Without wasting time, Leon opened the [Trading House] panel and placed the items on sale..
Once he finished, he closed the panel.
And only then did he hear Celeste speak.
"Thank you." It was the first time Leon had heard her voice clearly in here, "I... I don’t know how to repay you."
Leon turned toward her.
Celeste’s appearance was striking even among the many unique races within [Eternal Ascension].
Her long crimson hair was tied into twin ponytails.
And the tips of those ponytails were made of literal flames that burned gently without harming her.
In his previous life, Leon knew this moment likely marked the beginning of her tragedy.

The point where she was captured by the [Imperial Guild], exploited for her phoenix abilities, and eventually killed so that they could obtain the rare materials that phoenix-race players dropped upon death.
But now things had changed. Leon had interfered.
Which meant the entire flow of events would be completely different.
"You were just taken by surprise," Leon replied calmly. "I could tell you were strong even back in the [Intermediate Divine Temple]."
Celeste smiled faintly.
"I only cleared an S-Rank assessment in the [Advanced Divine Temple]," she admitted. "You cleared a God-Rank one. You’re much stronger."
Leon couldn’t deny that.
But at the same time, the fact that Celeste had conquered an S-Rank assessment already meant something incredible.
Her [Combat Power] was most likely around three hundred thousand.
At this stage of the game, that level of strength was extremely rare.
She was probably on the same level as Emilia.
Leon glanced around the area.
The players who had been watching earlier were still nearby, but none of them dared to approach.
After witnessing what Leon had just done to the [Imperial Guild], they clearly preferred to keep their distance.
"I think you’ll be fine for now," Leon said while nodding slightly. "Just focus on getting stronger."
He had already planned to leave [Divine Academy City] and explore the areas beyond it in [Higher Domain #1].
But just as he was about to turn around—
"Wait."
Celeste spoke again. Leon looked back.
"Where’s the other girl?" she asked. "The elf."
"Oh." Leon let out a small sigh, "She’s in another [Higher Domain]. We’ll meet up soon."
"Alright." Celeste nodded slowly.
For some reason, she didn’t want Leon to leave yet.
Normally, she avoided interacting with other players completely.
She never joined parties and never allowed anyone to get close to her.
Every person who approached her only did so because of her race.
But somehow... This human felt different.
Celeste tried to gather the courage to say something more.
To ask if she could perhaps travel with him for a while.
But the words stopped before they reached her lips.
’No.’ She lowered her gaze slightly, ’This human might be different... but I’m not ready to take that risk.’
Leon noticed the hesitation in her expression. He simply smiled faintly.
"You don’t need to say anything," he said calmly. "I understand."
Celeste was powerful.
Possibly one of the strongest players Leon had seen at this stage of the game.
And Leon himself wanted to eventually build a strong group of companions capable of facing the gods in the future.
But if she wasn’t ready yet, that was fine.
"I feel like we’ll meet again anyway," Leon said with a grin.
Celeste looked at him for a moment before bowing lightly.
"...I’ll repay you someday. I promise."
Then she picked up her spear and turned around.
Without looking back again, she walked toward the exit of the city.
Her goal was simple: get stronger.
As for Leon, he opened his status panel again.
His eyes focused on a single line.
[Eternal Coins: 432,020]
’Heh... nice.’
Around him, players had finally started reacting.
"Holy shit, what just happened?"
"That human is insanely strong! I want to recruit him!"
"Hold on, let me check his status panel!"
Leon didn’t waste even a single second.
Abyssal Slash!
His body melted into the shadows instantly.
Before anyone could properly see him move, he had already vanished.
But somewhere in the crowd, someone shouted loudly.
"OH MY GOD! IT WAS [CELESTIAL]!"
Leon frowned slightly. Someone had seen his ID.
Which meant people now knew exactly which [Higher Domain] he was currently in.
That information alone could attract many enemies.
Fortunately, Leon already had a plan.
As soon as the cooldown on his [World Map] ended, he intended to teleport directly to [Higher Domain #3].
No one would expect someone to travel between domains that quickly.
Fwoosh!
Leon left the city shortly afterward, his body emerging from the shadows outside the gates before he began running forward.
Ding!
[You have entered the "Vine Plains"]
This area was the first large open region where players could hunt monsters to gain experience.
Tall vines covered the land in every direction, twisting across the ground and wrapping around ancient stone pillars.
Leon walked forward calmly.
It didn’t take long before several creatures appeared in front of him.
[Vine Abomination]
[Level: 52]
[Combat Power: 167,000]
[Detail: Monsters made out of sentient vines created by the "Will of Nature"]
Leon stared at the monsters for a moment. Then he sighed.
"...I really am far too strong for these things."

chapters.title: Chapter 154: The Vine Plains, First Monsters in the Higher Domain
paragraphs: Leon’s current [Combat Power] had already reached a point where it was far beyond what most enemies around his level could possibly handle.
For the majority of players who first entered the [Higher Domain], having somewhere between 100,000 and 150,000 combat power was considered normal.
That range represented the expected strength of someone who had successfully cleared the [Advanced Divine Temple] and moved on to the next stage of the world.
The system behind the [Higher Domains] actually used that kind of strength to distribute players across the different regions.
For example, a player who had barely managed to complete the F-Rank assessment in the [Advanced Divine Temple] would not be sent to one of the top areas.
Instead, they would be transported somewhere much further down the list, such as [Higher Domain #98].
On the other hand, the first ten [Higher Domains] were reserved for the strongest and most promising players.
Those areas were far more dangerous.
Not only were the monsters stronger, but the players who appeared there were also much more capable than average.
Anyone who managed to enter one of those domains had already proven that they possessed talent, skill, or potential far beyond the norm.
However, something important needed to be clarified.
Even though Leon currently stood inside [Higher Domain #1], that did not mean it was automatically the hardest area in existence.
As mentioned before, the first ten domains were all designed to be roughly equal in overall difficulty.
Each of them simply offered different types of environments, opportunities, and threats.
Some had stronger monsters but better rewards, while others had special locations or rare events that could only appear there.
In other words, they were balanced differently rather than being strictly ranked in difficulty.
But regardless of those details, the monsters currently standing in front of Leon were not particularly threatening.
The group of [Vine Abominations] slowly crawled across the ground, their bodies made entirely of twisting vines that moved like living creatures.
Leon calmly raised his staff.
Powerful Fireball!
A sphere of blazing flames instantly formed at the tip of the weapon before shooting forward.
BOOM!
The fireball exploded the moment it struck the monsters.
The explosion scorched the surrounding ground, burning through the vines and destroying the creatures almost instantly.
The four monsters barely had time to react before their bodies collapsed into charred fragments.
Leon looked around after the explosion faded.
"...Damn."
The difference between him and the other players nearby was extremely obvious.
All across the [Vine Plains], other players were fighting similar monsters, but most of them were locked in intense battles, trading blows and carefully managing their abilities just to survive.
Meanwhile, Leon had eliminated four monsters in a single attack.
Ding!
[You have killed x4 "Vine Abomination" and gained 24,000 experience points.]
[100% Drop Rate has triggered...]
The notifications appeared immediately.
Leon opened his status panel and glanced at his level.
’Good... looks like it’s the same.’
He had been slightly worried about something.
Because of the bonuses from his [Celestial] title and several other advantages he possessed, Leon wanted to confirm whether the amount of experience required to level up had changed.
Fortunately, it seemed the progression remained normal.
From level 50 until level 75, the experience requirement for each level would increase by 20,000 compared to the previous one.
This meant that leveling up would slowly become more and more difficult as time passed.
And once he completed his fourth assessment inside the [Expert Divine Temple], the difficulty would rise even further.
Still, Leon wasn’t too concerned about that for now.
Instead, he opened his [Storage Space] to examine the items he had just obtained.
[Vine Abomination Essence x4: Consuming will increase Constitution by 12.]
[Vine Armor x4 (Uncommon): +2,300 Defense, +1,800 Constitution, +1,000 Agility. Has the ability to harm the opponent if comes in contact. Requirement: Level 54.]
"Nice."
As monsters grew stronger, the amount of attribute points granted by their essences also increased.
Without wasting time, Leon consumed the four essences.
Nom!
The energy spread through his body immediately.
His constitution increased by forty-eight points in total.
After that, he turned his attention toward the four pieces of armor.
Enhancing equipment by fusing identical items together was always worth attempting.
Beep!
[Enhancement failed.]
Leon didn’t react much. Failures were normal.
He tried again.
Ding!
[Enhancement successful.]
[Vine Armor +2 (Uncommon): +2,800 Defense, +2,200 Constitution, +1,400 Agility. Has the ability to harm the opponent if comes in contact. Requirement: Level 54.]
Leon glanced at the updated stats for a moment.
"Still not better than my [Elemental Dragon Armor +2]."
His current armor remained superior.
Still, the extra item could eventually be sold or used later if needed.
After finishing his small inventory management session, Leon stretched slightly.
It actually felt good to return to a simple routine of hunting monsters and leveling up after everything that had happened earlier.
The upcoming event inside [Divine Academy City] would begin in about two hours.
That meant Leon had roughly that amount of time to grow stronger before returning.
Which was more than enough for him to make progress.
’I guess I can head deeper.’
There was no real point in staying in the outer sections of the [Vine Plains].
The monsters here were only around level fifty.
Considering his current combat power, Leon could comfortably fight enemies as high as level sixty-five or even seventy without too much trouble.
Fwoosh!
With that decision made, Leon rushed forward across the plains.
As he moved deeper into the region, he quickly noticed how massive the area actually was.
And eventually... he met level-sixty monsters.
’Damn.’
The environment itself also began changing the further he went.
The vines covering the land became thicker and more aggressive, twisting around rocks and ruins like massive living snakes.
Some of them had grown solid enough to resemble wood, while others were covered in sharp thorns that glistened under the faint sunlight.
Eventually, Leon arrived at another group of monsters.
He immediately activated his appraisal.
[Carnivorous Plant]
[Level: 63]
[Exclusive Talent: Player Devour (B-Level)]
[Combat Power: 300,000]
[Details: Plants that get stronger after each player they devour, created by the "Will of Nature"]
Leon glanced at the information calmly.
The fact that their combat power had nearly doubled compared to the earlier monsters didn’t bother him too much.
Instead, something else caught his attention.
Once again, the description mentioned the same mysterious entity: the [Will of Nature].
This force seemed responsible for creating many of the monsters roaming this region.
Interestingly, it did not appear to be the same entity as the [Goddess of Nature].
Whether they were connected somehow remained unclear.
But Leon quickly noticed something else.
In the center of the group stood a larger plant monster.
[Carnivorous Plant (Mutated)]
[Level: 63]
[Combat Power: 330,000]
[Details: A carnivorous plant that has absorbed so many players it has mutated.]
Leon smiled slightly, "First mutated one in a while."
He lifted his staff.
"Let’s see."
Even though the creature’s combat power was high, Leon didn’t appear worried.
Powerful Fireball!
The flaming sphere shot forward.
BOOM!
The explosion engulfed the group instantly.
Most of the carnivorous plants were burned to ashes without resistance.
But one monster remained.
The mutated plant had somehow survived.
A barrier of thorns had appeared around its body, protecting it from the worst of the explosion.
The creature immediately lunged forward.
Its massive mouth opened wide as it tried to swallow Leon whole.
Leon reacted instantly.
’If I get eaten, I’ll die instantly... and [Life Vessel] won’t save me.’
The ability allowed him to revive after death on the spot.
But if he revived inside the monster’s stomach and died again immediately, the effect would become useless.
Situations like that were rare. But they were still dangerous.
Fwoosh!
Leon dodged to the side just as the giant mouth snapped shut.
Then he swung his sword.
SLASH!
The blade sliced straight through the monster’s mouth, cutting it in half with ease.
The plant reacted by launching several thick vines toward him.
Leon moved faster.
Slash! Slash! Slash!
Every vine was cut apart before it could reach him.
Then he raised his staff again.
Powerful Fireball!
The final blast hit the creature directly.
BOOM!
The mutated monster collapsed.

Leon had done it alone.
Ding!
[You have killed x3 "Carnivorous Plant" and gained 300,000 experience points.]
[You have killed "Carnivorous Plant (Mutated)" and gained 450,000 experience points.]
[100% Drop Rate has triggered...]
Leon blinked slightly, "Oh shit."
Since he was still only level fifty, defeating monsters more than ten levels higher than himself provided enormous amounts of experience.
And then the next notification appeared.
Ding!
[Congratulations, you have leveled up to Level 51 + Level 52 + Level 53!]
[Due to "Heaven’s Blessing", you have gained 1,200 points in all attributes and 1,200 free points to distribute.]
Leon smiled.
"Heh."
He could literally feel the increase in strength flowing through his body.
And he had no intention of slowing down.
If he wanted to achieve everything he had planned inside the [Higher Domains]... then this level of growth was only the beginning.

chapters.title: Chapter 155: Celeste’s Incredible Spearmanship, The Queen of Pheonix’s Pet
paragraphs: Leon was just about to open his [Storage Space] so he could check the items he had received from killing the carnivorous plants.
But before he could even bring up the panel, a sudden commotion among the nearby players caught his attention.
"Holy shit, look at her!"
"Damn... don’t get too close, she seems way too strong..."
The voices were filled with both amazement and caution, and the direction everyone was staring toward made Leon pause before he slowly turned around to see what was happening.
"Oh."
It didn’t take long for him to recognize the source of the excitement.
It was... Celeste again.
She was currently surrounded by a large horde of monsters that had gathered around her.
And yet despite the number of enemies around her, her expression remained completely calm and neutral as she rushed forward with her spear firmly gripped in her hands.
SLASH!
Her weapon moved with incredible precision.
With a single swing, she cut one of the approaching monsters in half.

And the moment the blade passed through the creature’s body, a burst of blazing phoenix flames erupted outward from the strike, scorching several of the nearby enemies that had attempted to surround her.
The flames crackled violently across the vines covering the ground.
But Celeste did not stop moving.
A vine-like creature suddenly burst out from beneath the soil behind her, its body twisting violently as it lunged toward her back in an attempt to catch her off guard.
However, she reacted instantly.
Her body moved with smooth precision as she jumped into the air, narrowly avoiding the attack before spinning around mid-air and driving her spear downward.
THUD!
The spear pierced straight through the monster’s body and pinned it into the ground before the phoenix flames erupted again, burning the creature from the inside out.
Celeste landed gracefully before pulling the spear back out and continuing forward.
The battle around her was chaotic.
Monsters attacked from all directions, emerging from the vines, lunging from underground, or charging from the front.
But she responded to every attack flawlessly.
She spun her spear in elegant arcs, cut through enemies with powerful thrusts, and released bursts of flames whenever her weapon struck something.
Leon watched the entire exchange carefully.
’Her spearmanship is amazing.’
Every movement she made was precise and efficient.
There was no hesitation or wasted motion.
’She really is very strong.’
Death did not carry the same consequences for phoenix-race players.
Even if they were killed, they could eventually revive through their race’s special abilities.
Because of that, many fought recklessly, relying on their racial traits to compensate for mistakes.
But Celeste was completely different.
Despite having that advantage, she fought with incredible discipline.
Leon could barely find any openings in her defense.
Every movement she made left her ready to counter the next attack.
Eventually, Celeste seemed to gather energy into her spear as she noticed another group of monsters approaching from the distance.
She spun the weapon once in her hands before suddenly throwing it forward.
BOOM!
The spear pierced through several monsters at once, impaling them in a straight line before exploding into a wave of blazing flames that spread outward and burned everything nearby.
At least a dozen monsters died instantly. Even Leon found himself slightly impressed.
Of course, he was capable of defeating these creatures as well, and probably even faster.
But seeing Celeste fight like that was still satisfying.
However, just as the battle began tilting completely in her favor—
ROOOOAR!
A powerful roar suddenly echoed across the plains.
The sound was deep and heavy, vibrating through the ground as if something massive had awakened beneath the vines.
Everyone nearby turned toward the source.
The ground began to shake slightly.
And then a gigantic creature slowly emerged from the earth.
[Wild Plant King (Boss)]
[Level: 65]
[Talent: Deep Earth Affinity (B-Level)]
[Combat Power: 380,000]
[Details: A lone plant chosen by the "Will of Nature" to become the king of other plants.]
The monster stood nearly three meters tall. Its body was formed entirely from thick twisting vines.
Bwere blooming across its body, giving it an oddly majestic yet terrifying appearance.
ROOOOAR!
The creature roared again as the vines forming its arms suddenly extended outward.
They lashed toward Celeste with tremendous force.
Many of the nearby players reacted instantly.
Several of them turned around and ran without hesitation.
Even though every person present had been strong enough to be transported to [Higher Domain #1], none of them wanted to risk their lives fighting a boss monster like that.
Leon, however, did not move.
He calmly readied both his sword and his staff, observing the situation carefully.
He could step in at any moment if necessary.
But for now, he wanted to see how Celeste would deal with such an opponent.
At first, the battle seemed to go surprisingly well for her.
Phoenix flames were a natural weakness for plant-based monsters.
Every time her spear struck the boss, the fire spread across its vines and forced it to retreat momentarily.
But even so, the [Wild Plant King] was still a boss-level creature. It adapted quickly.
More and more vines began emerging from the ground around Celeste, slowly surrounding her and limiting her movements.
Then suddenly—
SLAP!
A massive vine erupted behind her.
Celeste was busy deflecting two other attacks in front of her and couldn’t react in time.
The vine was about to strike her directly from behind.
And so at that exact moment, Leon decided to act.
Powerful Fireball!
He launched a blazing sphere of flames directly toward the boss monster.
BOOM!
The explosion struck the [Wild Plant King] squarely, interrupting its attacks and forcing the surrounding vines to recoil.
Leon’s fireball alone wasn’t enough to kill the boss.
But it was clear the creature had taken heavy damage.
Celeste quickly turned her head toward Leon.
Her eyes widened slightly when she recognized him.
Still, she gave him a quick nod, silently thanking him for the assistance.
ROOOOOAR!
The boss monster roared furiously.
Its body began shifting as the thorns across its vines sharpened, gathering energy as it prepared to unleash its strongest ability.
But before it could release the attack—
Fwoosh!
Something suddenly emerged from Celeste’s chest.
It looked like a tiny bird made of flames: a small phoenix.
"Kyu~"
The creature floated gently in the air. And Celeste smiled softly as she saw it.
She reached out and patted the small phoenix.
"Kill it," she said playfully. "And I’ll give you a treat."
"KYU!"
The tiny phoenix, roughly the size of a cat, flapped its fiery wings and floated higher into the air.
Then—
TORRENT OF FLAMES!
A massive pillar of fire erupted from the ground beneath the boss monster.
The flames surged upward violently, engulfing the [Wild Plant King] entirely.
"...What?"
Even Leon was caught off guard by the sheer scale of the attack.
He instinctively raised his arm to shield his face from the heat.
When the flames finally faded, the result was obvious.
The boss monster had completely disappeared. Its entire body had been reduced to ash.
The small phoenix slowly floated back down and landed comfortably on top of Celeste’s crimson hair.
"Thank you~" she said happily.
Leon ignored the system panels appearing around him for now and stepped forward.
"I did say we’d meet again," he said with a grin. "Though I didn’t expect it to happen... this quickly."
Celeste nodded slightly, "I appreciate the help again."
"You would’ve been fine," Leon replied calmly. "You have that thing after all."
Celeste gently patted the phoenix.
"Her name is Pyra. I received her as the reward for completing the S-Rank assessment in the [Intermediate Divine Temple]."
Leon raised an eyebrow, "And she hatched instantly?"
"It only took a few hours," Celeste explained. "But we’re still getting to know each other. She’s very strong."
Leon immediately activated [Appraisal] on the small phoenix.
[Queen of Phoenix’s]
[Name: Pyra]
[Level: 2]
[Rank: Ascendant]
[Skills: Torrent of Flames, Flame Sense...]
"Wow."
An Ascendant-Rank pet. That rank was only one level below Divine.
And considering her title as the "Queen of Phoenix’s," Pyra clearly possessed enormous potential.
’Amazing.’
Leon slowly extended his hand and gently patted the small phoenix.
"Kyu~"
The flames surrounding Pyra burned slightly, and Leon could feel the heat against his skin, but it still felt surprisingly pleasant.
Celeste blinked in surprise.
"I’m shocked she allowed you to do that," she admitted. "It took several attempts before she let me touch her!"
Leon laughed, "Hah, maybe it’s because I saved you earlier."
Then he suddenly realized something.
"Actually... that reminds me. Why didn’t you summon Pyra when Alexander tried to attack you earlier?"
Celeste sighed slightly, "I don’t fully control her yet. She comes out whenever she wants."
"Oh."
Leon understood immediately. Their bond probably wasn’t strong enough yet.
Still, judging from their interaction, Pyra’s loyalty toward Celeste would likely increase quickly over time.
"I don’t blame her," Celeste said. "But I still need to become stronger myself."
Leon nodded. The events had unfolded in a rather unexpected way.
But one thing was certain.
Since they were both in the same [Higher Domain], their paths were bound to cross again, over and over.
So Leon decided to ask something instead.
"If you’re planning to participate in the event at [Divine Academy City], why don’t we just stay together for now?"
Celeste froze slightly, and her entire body trembled.
She had actually wanted to ask him the same thing earlier, back when he saved her from the [Imperial Guild].1
But she hadn’t dared to take that risk.
Now, after Leon had helped her again, and even Pyra had accepted him...
She felt much safer around him. Slowly, a warm smile appeared on her face.
"You know what?" Her voice carried newfound confidence, "Why not?"1
The second waifu is here, I hope I did a good enough job introducing her!
Intense action stuff is about to happen soon, trust me!

Why didn’t you summon Pyra when Alexander tried to attack you earlier?"
Celeste sighed slightly, "I don’t fully control her yet.
She comes out whenever she wants."
"Oh."
Leon understood immediately.
Their bond probably wasn’t strong enough yet.
Still, judging from their interaction, Pyra’s loyalty toward Celeste would likely increase quickly over time.
"I don’t blame her," Celeste said.
"But I still need to become stronger myself."
Leon nodded.
The events had unfolded in a rather unexpected way.
But one thing was certain.
Since they were both in the same [Higher Domain], their paths were bound to cross again, over and over.
So Leon decided to ask something instead.
"If you’re planning to participate in the event at [Divine Academy City], why don’t we just stay together for now?"
Celeste froze slightly, and her entire body trembled.
She had actually wanted to ask him the same thing earlier, back when he saved her from the [Imperial Guild].1
But she hadn’t dared to take that risk.
Now, after Leon had helped her again, and even Pyra had accepted him...
She felt much safer around him.
Slowly, a warm smile appeared on her face.
"You know what?" Her voice carried newfound confidence, "Why not?"1
The second waifu is here, I hope I did a good enough job introducing her!
Intense action stuff is about to happen soon, trust me!

chapters.title: Chapter 156: Celeste’s Status Panel, SS-Level Eternal Embers Talent
paragraphs: Leon had asked Celeste to accompany him because he felt that the timing was right.
To be honest, he had not truly expected her to agree.
Considering everything she had possibly gone through, especially the ambush from the members of the Imperial Guild, it would have been perfectly understandable if she had decided to continue alone.
Yet things had changed slightly. Leon had saved her twice now.
The first time was during the confrontation with Alexander and his group, and the second time was only a few minutes ago when the Wild Plant King had nearly struck her from behind.
Those moments had probably softened her view of him.
"It’s the first time I ever accept," Celeste said with a gentle smile while patting the small phoenix resting on her head. "Let’s be partners."
Her voice was calm, but Leon could sense that this decision had not been made lightly.
Celeste slowly extended her hand toward him.
Leon looked at it for a brief moment before extending his own hand as well.
Their hands met in a firm handshake. And just like that, it was official.
Celeste had joined his party. Including himself, the group now had three people.
He would need to tell Emilia about it eventually, but he was almost certain she would not mind.
In fact, she might even be happy about it.
The more members they had, the easier it would become to deal with stronger monsters and dangerous situations.
Numbers mattered in a world like this.
A larger team meant more damage, more defense, and better coordination during battles.
"Alright," Leon looked at the horizon, "The [Vine Plains] are probably level 50-65 zone probably."
That was only an estimation, but it was a reasonable one.
Most of the monsters they had encountered were around level fifty or slightly higher, and the boss they had just killed, the Wild Plant King, had been level sixty-five.
It made sense for the area to be designed for players within that range.
Of course, this was only one region of [Higher Domain #1]
There would undoubtedly be many other zones beyond this one.
But for now, Leon focused on the present.
"And we only have around an hour left," he continued. "After that, we’ll head toward the event."
Celeste tilted her head slightly.
"Is it worth it?" she asked. "I’m worried the Imperial Guild or other players might appear again..."
Her concern was understandable.
Since arriving in the Higher Domain, she had already been targeted multiple times.
She had tried to avoid killing them whenever possible. But sometimes she had no choice.
If someone tried to kill her, she had to defend herself.
Because of that, she had already obtained the title [Slayer II].1
Leon scratched the back of his head slightly before responding.
"It’s fine," he said with a confident grin. "I don’t think they’ll be much of a problem now. At least not for me."
That was not arrogance. Leon simply knew his own strength.
He couldn’t deny that there were some very impressive and powerful players in the [Higher Domains].
But as of now, since they had only just entered, he wasn’t too bothered.
Hearing his confident tone, Celeste couldn’t help but nod.
A small smile appeared on her face, "Thanks, Celestial."
Leon blinked once as he heard that.
Celeste had obviously seen the global announcement before.
Seeing the real person behind that name probably made it easier for her to trust his confidence.
But something else suddenly occurred to him.
She had called him Celestial. Not Leon.
"The name’s Leon," he said. "You can check my [Status Panel] if you want. I don’t mind."
Celeste’s eyes brightened slightly.
"Oh," she said happily. "Thank you! You can call me Celeste... and you can call her Pyra!"
"Kyu~!"
The tiny phoenix sitting on her head flapped its fiery wings excitedly.
At the same time, Celeste opened one of her panels and quickly sent her complete [Status Panel] to Leon.
Normally, Leon’s Appraisal skill could only reveal part of another player’s information.
But if someone willingly shared their panel, then everything became visible.
A new window appeared before Leon.
[Name: Celeste Flamoir]
[ID: UndyingPhoenix]
[Level: 56]
[Title: Rebirth Frenzy, Slayer II]
[World: Undying (High-Level)]
[Talent: Eternal Embers (SS-Level)]
[Skills: Advanced Spearmanship (Rare Lv.3), Ember Ball (Uncommon Lv.4), Eye of Fury (Epic Lv.2), Flame Clone (Legendary Lv.1), Flame Throw (Elite Lv.1)]
[Sub-Talents: Strength Enhancement (D-Level)]
[Combat Power: 332,490]
Leon carefully studied the information. It was definitely interesting.
Celeste possessed several powerful skills, including a Legendary one.
However, most of them were still at relatively low levels. Her sub-talents were also quite limited.
Still, two things immediately stood out: her SS-Level Talent. And her Title.
Both of those were extremely valuable.
Together, they likely placed her among the stronger players in the Higher Domains at this stage.
"What does your talent and title do?" Leon asked calmly. "I need to know."
If they were going to work together, understanding each other’s abilities was important.
Leon was already thinking about ways he could help her become stronger.
Improving her sub-talents and equipment would be a good starting point.
Celeste nodded and answered immediately.
"Rebirth Frenzy reduces my revive time from one week to three days."
Leon’s eyebrows rose slightly, "Oh?"
That was incredible. Phoenix players already possessed the ability to revive after death.
But the downside was the long cooldown.
Normally, it took an entire week before they could return.
Reducing that time to three days was a massive advantage.
"And what about Eternal Embers?" Leon asked.
Celeste hesitated slightly, "I’m... confused about that one too."
"How?" Leon asked.
"Well..."
She tapped on her panel for a moment before sending another window to Leon.
[Eternal Embers (SS-Level): Allows you to use different types of embers, each one stronger than the last, to scorch your enemies.]
[Current Ember Types: Phoenix...]1
[Phoenix Embers: Burn down your foes and consume them to boost your attributes.]1
[You may unlock more "Embers" by ???]

"I won’t deny that the embers I have are extremely powerful as they helped me get attributes after each kill," Celeste explained. "But I feel like having more types would make it even stronger... I just don’t know how to unlock them."
Leon stared at the panel while rubbing his chin.
Even he was puzzled. The talent clearly had hidden mechanics. But the requirements were unknown.
And since Leon had never encountered this exact talent in his previous life, his past knowledge was useless here.
"I guess we’ll figure it out eventually," he said after a few seconds. "For now, it should be fine."
Celeste nodded.
Once the discussion ended, Leon closed the panel and shifted his attention to his Storage Space.
He still hadn’t properly checked the items that had dropped from the monsters.
Several notifications appeared.
[Carnivorous Plant Essence x3: Consuming will increase Constitution by 16.]
[Mutated Carnivorous Plant Essence: Consuming will increase Agility by 15 and Constitution by 20.]
[Wild Plant King Essence: Consuming will increase Constitution by 50, Strength by 30, and Agility by 25.]
[Vine Armor x4 (Uncommon)]
[Vine Boots x4 (Elite): +1,200 Agility, +800 Constitution.]
[Sub-Talent Scroll: Deep Earth Affinity (B-Level)]
And finally...
Two items that looked far more valuable than the rest.
[Skill Book: Vine Cataclysm (Legendary). Requirement: Defeat the "Wild Plant King".]

[Plant King Flower (Legendary): +1,000 Agility, +1,500 Constitution, +1,300 Strength. Equipping this item will prevent the vines of the "Will of Nature" from attacking you. Requirement: Defeat the "Wild Plant King".]
"Oh?"
Leon couldn’t help but grin. Those rewards were excellent.
Meanwhile, Celeste checked her own [Storage Space].
Unfortunately, she hadn’t received nearly as many items.
Aside from a few essences, there wasn’t much else.
Leon, on the other hand, decided to start immediately. He consumed all the essences.
Nom!
[+118 Constitution, +40 Agility, +30 Strength.]
"Nice."
He then moved on to the equipment, fusing the [Vine Armor and [Vine Boots].
In the end, two of the enhancements worked.
This left him with a [Vine Armor +2].
But more importantly, he obtained [Vine Boots +2].
[Vine Boots +2 (Elite): +1,500 Agility, +1,000 Constitution.]
Those were significantly better than the [Darkness Fur Boots +4] he was currently wearing.
Without hesitation, Leon replaced them.
Then he turned his attention to the Legendary skill book.
Fwish!
Leon poured mana into it.
The book dissolved into glowing particles that flowed into his body.
A notification appeared.
[You have learned the skill "Vine Cataclysm (Legendary)"]
[Vine Cataclysm (Legendary): Summon multiple vines from the ground to attack and restrain your enemies.]
"Nice."
A new skill was always welcome. Especially a Legendary one.
As for the [Sub-Talent Scroll], he didn’t need to learn it since he already had [Master of Elements (SS-Level)]
Leon was about to close the panel and move on to the final item.
But suddenly—
Ding!
A familiar notification appeared.
["Celestial Hand" has activated on "Wild Plant King".]
[Please choose one of the items dropped.]
[1. Wild Plant King Essence.]
[2. Skill Book: Vine Cataclysm (Legendary).]
[3. Plant King Flower (Legendary).]
[4. Sub-Talent Scroll: Deep Earth Affinity (B-Level)]
Leon froze for a second. Then a slow grin spread across his face.
"Oh." His eyes gleamed with interest, "I guess that’s... good."
