chapters.title: Chapter 181: Teleporting to Higher Domain #3
paragraphs: Leon’s eyes snapped open instantly, a grin forming on his face as he stood up.
"Finally."
He walked over to the bed and gently woke Celeste, who slowly opened her eyes, rubbing them as she stretched.
"That was really comfortable~" she yawned, smiling lazily. "I guess it’s time to go, huh?"
"Break’s over," Leon nodded.
He opened the [World Map], and the interface expanded before them, revealing a vast void filled with one hundred glowing circles, each representing a different [Higher Domain].
Without hesitation, Leon selected [Higher Domain #3].
Ding!
[Do you wish to teleport to "Higher Domain #3"?]
Before confirming, he turned to Celeste.
"Hold on to me again," he said calmly, "This one might be a bit rough, and there’s a chance you might not come with me, so if that happens, just stay calm and I’ll contact you."
"Alright," Celeste nodded, letting Pyra return to her [Pet Space].
Leon exhaled lightly.
"It might hurt quite a lot though, so... just endure it."
"Wait what—"
Ding!
Before she could finish, the teleportation activated.

Their surroundings twisted violently as space itself seemed to collapse around them, and an intense sensation surged through their bodies, as if their very souls were being torn apart and reconstructed at the same time.
The pain was far worse than anything Leon had experienced when traveling between lower domains, and for a brief moment, it felt like everything might break.
Still... he endured.
And then—
Fwoosh! Ding!
[You have appeared in "Higher Domain #3"]
[Domain Travel Cooldown: 23 Hours 59 Minutes 59 Seconds.]
Ding!
[You have appeared in "Higher Domain #3"]
The moment the notification echoed in his mind, Leon didn’t even bother looking around or checking anything else.
His first instinct was to turn toward Celeste and make sure that she had made it through the teleportation safely, especially after the violent sensation they had just endured.
"Hah... hah..."
Celeste was bent slightly forward, her breathing uneven as her chest rose and fell quickly.
Her eyes were trembling faintly as she tried to stabilize herself after the process, clearly shaken by the intensity of what they had just experienced.
Leon immediately stepped closer to her, his expression tightening slightly as he observed her condition, ready to react if something was wrong.
"You alright?" he asked calmly, though there was a hint of concern in his voice.
Celeste took a few seconds to catch her breath before straightening herself, forcing a faint smile despite the lingering discomfort.
"Damn... I guess [Domain Travel] is no joke," she muttered, still recovering from the shock.
Leon nodded slightly, though even he hadn’t expected it to be this rough, especially for someone who wasn’t used to it.
"At least it worked," he replied, clearly more focused on the outcome than the process itself.
And it truly was something worth noting, because the fact that he could bring someone else along with him using [Domain Travel] was something incredibly valuable.
If it hadn’t worked, things would have been much more complicated.
He trusted her strength, of course, but being separated again would have been hard.
Now though, that problem didn’t exist.
Once Celeste had fully recovered, the two of them finally shifted their attention to their surroundings, and the moment they did, both of them froze slightly.
"What?"

They were standing in the middle of a massive square, surrounded by stone buildings and wide pathways, with countless players scattered all around them, each one looking just as confused as they were.
More precisely, the spawn point of this entire domain was located right here.
Before they could fully process it though, another panel appeared in front of them.
Ding!
[You have entered the "Awakener Kingdom"]
[Please grow stronger by completing quests, clearing realms and pushing through the districts.]
[Perhaps you will be able to face the "Awakener Lord" and only then ascend.]
"What the hell?"
Even Leon couldn’t help but react this time, his brows furrowing slightly as he read the message again, trying to make sense of it.
This was... different. Very different.
Even with all the knowledge he had from his previous life, he had never encountered something like this before.
Still, that didn’t surprise him too much.
Information about the first ten [Higher Domains] wasn’t something easily accessible, and most players didn’t dare go there either.
"That’s... quite different from [Higher Domain #1]," Celeste said, her tone uncertain but curious at the same time.
"Yeah," Leon nodded slowly, "But it doesn’t matter, we’ll figure it out."
No matter how unfamiliar the situation was, they would adapt, just like everyone else here.
After all, judging by the number of players around them, they weren’t the only ones trying to understand what was going on.
"What the hell’s the [Awakener Kingdom]?"
"I guess it’s different my [Lower Domain] huh..."
Hundreds, if not thousands of players were standing around, looking at their panels, talking among themselves, or simply observing the area.
All of them were clearly newcomers just like Leon and Celeste.
Leon didn’t waste time though.
He immediately opened his [Friends List], his eyes scanning through the names quickly: Eleonore, David, Aaron and Alice.
As expected, all of them were still in [Lower Domain #1], but Emilia’s location stood out.
[Location: Higher Domain #3]
"Good," Leon muttered.
She was still here. That meant they wouldn’t have to figure everything out blindly.
But as he was about to message her, something suddenly clicked in his mind.
He paused. Then slowly turned his head toward Celeste.
"Wait a damn minute," he said.
"Hm?" Celeste tilted her head, confused by his reaction.
"We didn’t add each other as friends."
There was a brief silence. Celeste blinked once, then opened her own [Friends List].
[Friends: 0]
"Oh..." The realization hit her immediately.

As said before, since the moment she had entered [Eternal Ascension], she had avoided interacting with others as much as possible, ignoring friend requests and invitations without even thinking about it.
She had no way of knowing who had good intentions and who didn’t, so she simply chose not to trust anyone.
But now... That didn’t really apply anymore.
Right as she thought that, a panel appeared in front of her.
Ding!
[You have received a friend request from "Celestial"]
Celeste stared at the panel for a few seconds, then a small smile appeared on her face as she accepted it without hesitation.
Ding!
[You have added "Celestial" as a friend.]
[Friends: 1]
Her list was no longer empty. Leon’s name was now there.
Meanwhile, Leon had already shifted his focus back to Emilia, selecting her name and sending a message.
[Celestial: I have arrived at "Higher Domain #3", can you come to the spawn square please?]
He didn’t expect an immediate response, considering she could be busy with something else, but surprisingly, the reply came almost instantly.
[Saintess: I saw your domain number change so I was already heading your way hehe~! I’ll explain everything about this place once I’m there.]
Leon raised an eyebrow slightly, "That was fast."
"She was already coming?" Celeste asked, a bit surprised.
"Seems like it," Leon nodded.
Then, with a faint smile, he added, "I didn’t tell her about you, so she’ll probably be surprised."

[You have received a friend request from "Celestial"]
Celeste stared at the panel for a few seconds, then a small smile appeared on her face as she accepted it without hesitation.
Ding!
[You have added "Celestial" as a friend.]
[Friends: 1]
Her list was no longer empty.
Leon’s name was now there.
Meanwhile, Leon had already shifted his focus back to Emilia, selecting her name and sending a message.
[Celestial: I have arrived at "Higher Domain #3", can you come to the spawn square please?]
He didn’t expect an immediate response, considering she could be busy with something else, but surprisingly, the reply came almost instantly.
[Saintess: I saw your domain number change so I was already heading your way hehe~!
I’ll explain everything about this place once I’m there.]
Leon raised an eyebrow slightly, "That was fast."
"She was already coming?" Celeste asked, a bit surprised.
"Seems like it," Leon nodded.
Then, with a faint smile, he added, "I didn’t tell her about you, so she’ll probably be surprised."

chapters.title: Chapter 182: Celeste and Emilia’s Meeting, Introduction to Higher Domain #3 [1]
paragraphs: Hearing that, Celeste froze for a brief moment before quickly adjusting her posture, fixing her hair and trying to look as presentable as possible.
She clearly remembered Emilia from before.
More importantly... she knew that Emilia was important to Leon.
And if they were going to travel together from now on, then she wanted to make a good impression.
Leon noticed her reaction and couldn’t help but smirk slightly.
"Don’t stress too much," he said, "Emilia won’t judge... I think."
The small pause at the end didn’t help much, but Celeste still nodded, trying to calm herself down.
And so... they waited.
The square remained lively, filled with players moving around, talking, or preparing to explore the kingdom.
But for Leon and Celeste, time seemed to slow down slightly as they stood there, waiting for Emilia to arrive.
Then, after around ten minutes—
"Leon!" A familiar voice called out from one of the streets leading into the square.
Both Leon and Celeste turned toward the sound.
And then—
Fwoosh!
A figure rushed toward them at high speed before jumping straight into Leon’s arms.
"Hehe, good thing we can meet again!" Emilia said with a bright smile, clearly happy.
Leon caught her without issue, nodding slightly.
"Yeah, makes things easier."
Without the [World Map], finding each other in a place like this would have taken much longer.
After a brief moment, Emilia pulled back, still smiling, before her gaze shifted toward Celeste.
"Oh?" her expression lit up even more, "You’re the girl from before!"
"M-My name is Celeste," Celeste said quickly, bowing slightly, "I’ve been traveling with Leon for a short time!"
Emilia glanced at Leon with a playful smile.
"Heh, I guess it didn’t take you long to replace me."
Leon shrugged casually.
"Oh well," Emilia laughed, clearly not bothered at all, "I don’t mind as long as she’s strong."
"She is," Leon confirmed without hesitation.
Celeste relaxed slightly after hearing that, realizing that Emilia didn’t seem to have any negative reaction.
In fact... she seemed pretty easygoing.
"Good," Emilia nodded, then clapped her hands lightly, "Then let’s get to the important part."
She stepped slightly in front of them, her expression turning a bit more serious, though the smile never fully disappeared.
"I’ll explain how this domain works," she said.
Leon nodded immediately, his focus sharpening. Celeste did the same, her curiosity growing.

"So basically, this [Higher Domain] is entirely inside of this [Awakener Kingdom]," Emilia began as she walked slightly ahead of Leon and Celeste, her voice calm but filled with excitement, "There is a world outside, but the natives here all say that beyond the borders of the kingdom, there is nothing but level 100 monsters that can tear anything apart without even trying."
Leon listened carefully, his eyes scanning the surroundings while processing her words.
Even though he had already expected something unusual, this still felt completely different from anything he had experienced before.

"Is there a way to go outside?" Leon asked without hesitation, his curiosity immediately kicking in as he thought about possible opportunities that others might have overlooked, "Maybe there’s something out there worth the risk."
The moment he asked that, Emilia shook her head almost instantly, her expression turning a little more serious.

"No idea," she replied, "but from what I heard, anyone who tried to leave the kingdom was killed almost immediately, so even if there is something out there, nobody has managed to come back and talk about it."
"Damn," Leon muttered under his breath, though instead of feeling discouraged, his interest only grew stronger.
If something was that dangerous, then it also meant that it could be hiding something incredibly valuable.
But for now, he knew better than to rush into something like that without proper preparation.

"The [Awakener Kingdom] itself is divided into three main districts," Emilia continued, "there’s the [Newbie District], which is for players between level 50 and 75, the [Advanced District] for players between level 75 and 90, and finally the [Awakener District], which is meant for players between level 90 and 100."
She paused for a brief moment before adding, "And right now, we’re in the [Newbie District], which explains why everything looks a bit... rough."

"This is so confusing!" Celeste suddenly groaned as she held her head, clearly overwhelmed by how different everything was compared to what she had seen before, "Why is this [Higher Domain] so different from ours?! I thought things would be somewhat similar, but this feels like a completely different world!"
Hearing that, Emilia couldn’t help but grin slightly, clearly amused by Celeste’s reaction.

"Don’t act too surprised," she said with a light laugh, "because from what I’ve heard, the first ten [Higher Domains] are all unique, not just in terms of zones, but also in how they function entirely."
Leon’s eyes narrowed slightly as he focused on that detail.
"By that you mean...?" he asked, wanting her to elaborate further.
"Exactly what I said," Emilia replied as she turned around and walked backward for a few steps while facing them.

"This domain is a kingdom where everything happens inside, while I heard that [Higher Domain #2] is made up of multiple islands that players have to travel between by crossing a dangerous sea filled with monsters."
These were the only details she had managed to gather so far, and even then, they already painted a very clear picture.
It was the first time Leon had heard anything about [Higher Domain #2], and even though it wasn’t immediately relevant, he made sure to remember it.
He didn’t know if he would ever go there, but if he did, he would definitely need to be prepared for something completely different once again.
"I’m guessing this kingdom is massive then," Leon said as he looked around, observing the endless streets filled with players and natives moving around constantly.
"Yep~" Emilia nodded with a smile, "there are probably millions of players and natives here, and the deeper you go into the kingdom, the more advanced everything becomes."
Leon could already imagine that the [Awakener District] would be the place where the strongest players gathered.
And naturally, it would also be where the greatest risks and rewards existed.

chapters.title: Chapter 183: Introduction to Higher Domain #3 [2]
paragraphs: "Still," Emilia continued, her tone becoming a bit more serious again, "moving from one district to another isn’t something you can do freely."
"Oh?" Leon raised an eyebrow, clearly interested.

"To go from the [Newbie District] to the [Advanced District], you need to complete your assessment once you reach level 75," she explained, "and after that, if you want to enter the [Awakener District], you need to pass a special test given by the [Awakener Lord]."
That was pretty much everything Emilia knew about the structure of this place so far, and Leon simply nodded as he processed the information.
By this point, he had already formed a clear understanding of how this domain worked.
And even though it was different, it wasn’t something he couldn’t adapt to.

’It’s crazy to think that some players might spend years inside this kingdom,’ Leon thought as he looked at the buildings around him, many of which looked worn down, ’but I guess in some areas, it must feel almost like a normal life.’
The place they were currently in, however, was far from that.
The streets were crowded, the buildings were simple, and there was a constant noise in the air that made it clear this was just the starting point for everyone.
"Don’t worry," Emilia said with a confident grin as if she could read their thoughts, "you can think of this as the outskirts of the kingdom, things get much better once you move further in."
"Alright," Leon replied calmly.
Both he and Celeste knew that they would need to adapt to this new environment quickly.
Because unlike [Higher Domain #1], where they had more freedom to explore, this place was more structured and restricted.
Still, the sheer size of the [Awakener Kingdom] meant that there would be plenty of opportunities hidden within it.
As they continued walking, Leon suddenly thought of something important.
"But wait a minute," he said as he looked at Emilia, "how do you even level up here if everything is inside the kingdom and the dangerous monsters are outside where nobody can survive?"
Hearing that, Emilia’s smile grew even wider, almost as if she had been waiting for that exact question.
"I wondered the same thing when I first got here," she admitted, "but once I figured it out, it actually made a lot of sense."
She then pointed forward toward a massive tower-like structure in the distance.
"Let’s head to the [Central Hub]," she said, her tone filled with excitement, "you’ll understand everything once we get there."
Leon and Celeste exchanged a brief glance, both of them curious about what she meant.
And without saying anything else, they simply nodded and followed her.
As they continued walking deeper into the [Newbie District], the atmosphere around them slowly began to change in a very noticeable way.
The streets that had once felt cramped and chaotic were now much wider, allowing players and natives to move more freely without constantly bumping into one another.
And the buildings themselves no longer looked worn down or hastily constructed, instead appearing more refined, organized, and even somewhat elegant in their design.
The number of guards patrolling the area increased significantly, along with the presence of groups of players who seemed far more disciplined and focused.

"Players from the [Advanced District] and [Awakener District] are not allowed to enter the [Newbie District]," Emilia explained calmly as she walked slightly ahead of Leon and Celeste, occasionally glancing back at them, "which means that for now, this place should be relatively safe for people at our level."
Leon and Celeste both nodded as they listened, slowly starting to piece together how this [Awakener Kingdom] truly functioned beyond just its surface-level structure.
Even though they understood the basics now, they both knew that actually experiencing it firsthand would be the only way to fully grasp everything.
"Makes me wonder," Leon suddenly spoke as he looked at Emilia with a faint smile forming on his face, "what did you get in your assessment?"
Hearing that, Emilia immediately smiled back.
"Unfortunately, no x5 multiplier on Strength or Agility," she replied with a light shrug, clearly aware of what Leon was hinting at.
"Damn, too bad," Leon shook his head as if he was genuinely disappointed, "that would have been amazing."
"Heh... I don’t really need Strength anyway," Emilia said, brushing a strand of her hair behind her ear, "but Agility would have been nice, I won’t deny that."
As she said that, Emilia opened her status panel without hesitation and quickly sent the relevant information to both Leon and Celeste.
"My talent gained a new passive," she added, "and I also got a new skill, both of them are pretty strong, so I can’t really complain."
Leon and Celeste immediately focused on the panels that appeared before them.
They carefully read through everything she had just shared.
[Elven Saintess (SS-Level): You are the saintess of all elven races, whether normal elves, dark elves or high elves, you stand above them all as their saintess.]
[Your reputation with all races is increased slightly more than anybody else, making them more eager to cooperate with you.]
[Your magical abilities are significantly boosted, you do not need to chant or use too much mana to cast spells, and your cooldowns are reduced as well.]
[Your relationship with beasts is among the best there is, and they will always be loyal to you no matter what.]
[New Passive: You can sense danger coming your way much more efficiently, allowing you to predict whether something catastrophic will happen to you or your companions.]
Leon read through it once, his expression remaining calm as he already knew of most of it.
"Yeah," he nodded, "that new passive is pretty good."
On the other hand, this was the very first time Celeste had ever seen Emilia’s talent in full detail.
And the moment she finished reading it, her eyes began to sparkle with amazement.
"Wow..." she said without holding back, "your talent is way better than mine, it’s so much more versatile and useful in every situation!"
Without hesitation, Celeste also sent her own talent panel to Emilia, allowing her to see it clearly.
Emilia read through it quickly, and almost immediately, a grin spread across her face.
"You must be joking~" she said, clearly amused, "your talent is insanely strong, you just need more [Embers]."
"I’ve been trying to find a way to get more," Leon added with a slight shake of his head, "but so far, nothing. We’ll have to figure it out eventually."
Once again, Leon briefly considered using his [Divine Answer] to get a guaranteed solution, but he dismissed the idea.
That skill was far too valuable to waste on something that could likely be discovered through exploration and experience.
Still, there was no doubt in his mind that obtaining more [Embers] would drastically increase Celeste’s strength.
As for the skill Emilia had obtained, Leon turned his attention to the next panel.
[Star Comet (Ancient Lv.1): Use the power of your Spirit to summon a star comet from the sky to annihilate your enemies.]
"Ancient-rank," Leon nodded, "Indeed, it’s incredibly powerful."
That was only one rank below ascendant after all.

chapters.title: Chapter 184: The Central Hub and Awakener Association
paragraphs: Considering that Emilia already had a massive [Spirit] stat along with her multipliers, [Star Comet] could easily devastate enemies far stronger than her level.
Overall, it was clear that Emilia had grown significantly stronger during the time she and Leon had been apart.
She was now level 68, and her [Combat Power] was around 680,000, which placed her firmly among the strongest players in their current range.
Leon now had a clear understanding of both Celeste and Emilia’s capabilities.
But the same couldn’t be said for the two girls regarding each other.
And so, as they continued heading toward the [Central Hub], the two of them naturally began sharing their panels in more detail.
They discussed their skills, sub-talents, and such.
Allowing them to better understand how they could work together as a team moving forward.
"You really are strong..." Celeste said with widened eyes after going through Emilia’s stats, "you’re only one level above me, but your [Combat Power] is so much higher..."
"Sub-talents make a huge difference," Emilia replied casually, "once you get more of them, you’ll catch up quickly, don’t worry~"
Leon smiled slightly as he watched the two of them interact.
It was clear that they were getting along well, and more importantly, they didn’t seem to have any issues trusting each other.
There were no secrets between them now, which would make things much easier in future battles.
Emilia even decided to take it a step further and sent a friend request to Celete.
Ding!
[You have added "Saintess" as a friend.]
[Friends: 2]
She now had two people in her [Friend List], and the small smile on her face made it clear that this meant more to her than she let on.
"Oh yeah, before I forget..." Celeste suddenly said, "come out, Pyra!"
Fwoosh!
In an instant, a burst of flames appeared in front of them, and Pyra emerged from Celeste’s chest, hovering in the air with a soft glow surrounding her.
The moment Emilia saw the small phoenix, her eyes lit up instantly.
"Oh my god!" she exclaimed, completely captivated by the sight.
"She’s my pet," Celeste explained proudly, "we’re growing stronger together.
"Kyu~"
Emilia slowly extended her hand toward Pyra, and to her surprise, the small phoenix didn’t hesitate at all, allowing her to gently pet her.
"I guess she likes you," Celeste nodded, clearly pleased, "that’s a good sign."
Leon couldn’t help but wonder if this reaction had something to do with Emilia’s [Elven Saintess] talent, especially considering its effects on beasts.
Still, regardless of the reason, everything seemed to be going smoothly.
Pyra flew around the three of them for a few seconds, letting out soft, cheerful sounds as if enjoying the moment.
But eventually...
"Alright, come back," Celeste said, her tone turning slightly more serious, "we don’t want to attract too much attention."
And she was right.
Several people had already started glancing in their direction, clearly drawn by the rare sight of a phoenix.
Fwoosh!
Without resisting, Pyra returned to Celeste’s [Pet Space], disappearing just as quickly as she had appeared.
With that, the introductions were officially complete.
"We’re close now," Emilia said as she looked ahead.
After a few more minutes of walking, the three of them finally reached what appeared to be the very center of the [Newbie District].
"Here it is," Emilia announced as they stepped into a massive open square filled with tens of thousands of players moving in every direction.
Several large buildings surrounding the area, each one radiating importance.
"The [Central Hub]."
Leon and Celeste both stopped for a moment, their eyes scanning the scene before them.
The main thing that caught their attention was the giant tower-like building that stood at the very center of everything.
Rising far above the rest of the structures as if it was the true heart of this entire district, drawing in countless players who constantly moved in and out of it without pause.
And above it, glowing clearly for everyone to see, were the words... [Awakener Association].
"Are you kidding me?" Leon groaned as he stared at the building, "There’s something like this in a [Higher Domain]?"
To him, it felt almost too organized, too structured, like something you would expect in a real world system rather than a chaotic progression-based one.

"Many people decide to live their entire lives in this place," Emilia explained calmly, as if this wasn’t surprising at all to her anymore, "so I think something like this actually makes sense, it keeps everything organized and makes things easier for everyone."
Leon thought about it for a brief moment before nodding slowly.
"Alright," he said, "I trust you.
"S-Same!" Celeste quickly added, clearly not wanting to be left out as she looked at the massive building with a mix of curiosity and excitement.
Without wasting any more time, the three of them began walking toward the [Awakener Association], following the steady flow of players who were entering and leaving constantly.
The closer they got, the more imposing the structure felt, and once they finally stepped inside, it became immediately clear just how massive it truly was.
The interior was enormous, far larger than what the outside suggested, with high ceilings, wide pathways, and different sections filled with players.

"There are three main areas inside the association," Emilia began explaining as they moved forward, more familiar with the place than the other two, "the [Market], the [Quests] section, and the [Realms]."
"Hm," Leon nodded as he listened, already starting to piece together how everything worked.
But before he could say anything else, both he and Celeste suddenly had panels appear right in front of them.
Ding!
[New players detected in "Newbie District"]
[You have been signed up into the "Awakener Association" as "Celestial"]
[Please complete quests and become stronger to improve your odds of meeting the "Awakener Lord" and get rewards!]

"You get signed up the moment you enter?" he asked.
"Yep," Emilia nodded with a small smile, "don’t worry though, it’s only beneficial, there’s no downside to it."
"Interesting..." Leon murmured as he scratched his chin, "this is the first time I’ve seen something like this."
"I also heard that every district has its own [Awakener Association]," Emilia added, "but the higher you go, the more intense everything becomes."
"What do you mean by more intense?" Celeste asked, tilting her head slightly.

"The [Quests] and the [Realms]," Emilia replied, her expression turning a bit more serious, "and I’m not exaggerating when I say this, I’ve already tried a few, and they can get really brutal depending on the difficulty you choose."
"Damn," Leon muttered, clearly taking note of that.
If even Emilia, who was already quite strong, considered them difficult, then it meant they weren’t something to take lightly.
At the same time, it answered an important question he had earlier: this was how players leveled up in this domain.
Instead of roaming freely and hunting monsters like before, they would enter these environments, the so-called [Realms], and fight within them.
Unlike normal zones, these [Realms] were much larger, more open, and far more dangerous.

They also contained something known as a [Realm Boss], which Emilia had mentioned was significantly stronger than a typical [Zone Boss], to the point where most players didn’t even attempt to challenge them.
’Makes sense,’ Leon thought, his eyes scanning the surroundings as he watched players moving between different sections of the building.

Overall, it was clear that Emilia had grown significantly stronger during the time she and Leon had been apart.

Leon now had a clear understanding of both Celeste and Emilia’s capabilities.
But the same couldn’t be said for the two girls regarding each other.

They discussed their skills, sub-talents, and such.
Allowing them to better understand how they could work together as a team moving forward.

Leon smiled slightly as he watched the two of them interact.
It was clear that they were getting along well, and more importantly, they didn’t seem to have any issues trusting each other.
There were no secrets between them now, which would make things much easier in future battles.
Emilia even decided to take it a step further and sent a friend request to Celete.

She now had two people in her [Friend List], and the small smile on her face made it clear that this meant more to her than she let on.

Fwoosh!

The moment Emilia saw the small phoenix, her eyes lit up instantly.

"She’s my pet," Celeste explained proudly, "we’re growing stronger together.
"Kyu~"
Emilia slowly extended her hand toward Pyra, and to her surprise, the small phoenix didn’t hesitate at all, allowing her to gently pet her.
"I guess she likes you," Celeste nodded, clearly pleased, "that’s a good sign."
Leon couldn’t help but wonder if this reaction had something to do with Emilia’s [Elven Saintess] talent, especially considering its effects on beasts.
Still, regardless of the reason, everything seemed to be going smoothly.
Pyra flew around the three of them for a few seconds, letting out soft, cheerful sounds as if enjoying the moment.
But eventually...
"Alright, come back," Celeste said, her tone turning slightly more serious, "we don’t want to attract too much attention."
And she was right.
Several people had already started glancing in their direction, clearly drawn by the rare sight of a phoenix.
Fwoosh!

chapters.title: Chapter 185: Awakener Panel, To The Quests Section
paragraphs: Everything about this place felt structured, almost like a system built to guide players step by step, while still leaving room for risk and reward.
"So..." Emilia suddenly spoke again, her tone lightening as she turned toward Leon and Celeste with a smile, "what do you guys want to do first?"
"We can explore a bit, check out the [Market], look at some [Quests], or just head straight into the [Realms] if you want to start leveling immediately."
Hearing that, Leon actually paused for a moment. He brought his hand to his chin, thinking carefully.
On one hand, jumping straight into the [Realms] would allow them to grow stronger immediately, which was always his priority.
But on the other hand, this place was completely new, and understanding it properly could give them a massive advantage later on.
"Well," Leon finally said as a small smile appeared on his face, "since we’re going to be in this [Higher Domain] for a while, we might as well take some time to understand everything first."
He glanced around the massive interior of the [Awakener Association], his eyes sharp and focused.
"No point rushing in blind."
Emilia’s smile widened slightly as she heard that.
"Good choice," she said.
And just like that, the three of them began moving deeper into the [Awakener Association], more precisely towards the [Quest] section.
While they were walking toward the [Quests] section of the [Awakener Association], Emilia suddenly turned her head slightly and looked at both Leon and Celeste.
"Did you both check your [Awakener Panels]?" she asked, her tone casual, "It could help a lot, since it’s going to matter quite a bit in this place."
Leon didn’t answer immediately, though the thought crossed his mind right away.
He already knew that he wouldn’t be able to leave [Higher Domain #3] until the cooldown of [Domain Travel] reset.
Which meant that for at least the next day, or possibly longer depending on his decisions, he would have to operate within this domain and adapt to its systems.
And so, without wasting any time, Leon opened the panel Emilia had mentioned.
[ID: Celestial]
[District: Newbie]
[Awakener Rank: F-Rank]
Leon stared at the simple panel for a moment, his eyes narrowing slightly as he processed the information displayed before him.
Beside him, Celeste also opened hers and looked at it with curiosity.
"So this is how they classify players here..." Leon murmured, his tone thoughtful.

"Some people believe that only an SS-Rank awakener can actually meet the [Awakener Lord]," Emilia continued as they walked down a long hallway filled with players moving in both directions, "Right now, I’m C-Rank, which isn’t bad at all, though I’m guessing that progressing further will require moving to the next district eventually."
"I wonder who the hell this [Awakener Lord] even is," Leon said as he glanced around the place, "This entire domain feels like it revolves around them."
And that wasn’t an exaggeration.
From the moment they arrived, everything, from the system messages to the structure of the kingdom, seemed to revolve around this single figure.
As if reaching them was the ultimate goal of everyone trapped within this domain.
While Leon was thinking about that, Celeste, who had been quietly observing everything, suddenly spoke up.
"But what’s the point of these ranks besides meeting that [Awakener Lord]?" she asked, tilting her head slightly.
Her confusion made sense. It felt strange for an entire system to exist just for this one purpose.
Emilia couldn’t help but smile slightly at that question before answering.

"Your life here depends entirely on your rank," Emilia explained patiently, "For example, people with higher ranks get access to better housing, better facilities, and even the [Market] has sections that are restricted based on rank."
Leon’s eyes sharpened slightly as he heard that. So that’s how it worked.
This wasn’t just a ranking system, it was a full hierarchy.
It was almost like a system of nobility, where those with higher ranks were treated better, had access to more resources, and lived more comfortably, while those stuck at the bottom struggled.
’No wonder so many players decided to stay here.’
For some, this place probably felt more stable than constantly risking their lives in another [Higher Domain].
Emilia, being C-Rank, wasn’t at the top, but within the [Newbie District], that was already considered quite high.
She was easily among the stronger and more respected players here.
Eventually, after walking through several crowded corridors filled with noise and movement, the three of them finally arrived at the [Quest] hall.
The moment they stepped inside, the sheer scale of the place became obvious.

Players filled every corner of the hall, some standing in groups discussing strategies, others rushing toward different boards, and many simply staring at the available quests with focused expressions.
And then...
Ding!
[Welcome to the "Quest" section of the "Awakener Association"]
[Please take up a quest to hopefully improve your rank and acquire more rewards!]

"This is the only way to improve your rank," Emilia said with a small smile as she looked around, clearly familiar with the place by now, "So taking quests is basically mandatory if you want to progress here."
All around them, large digital boards floated in the air, displaying countless quests for players to choose from.
Leon walked up to one of them, his gaze scanning the options quickly before stopping on a few entries.
[D-Rank Quest: Kill the "Snow Tiger" in the "Snowy Mountain" realm.]
[Reward: D-Rank Promotion and 5 Skill Stones.]
[E-Rank Quest: Collect some herbs in the "Enchanted Forest" realm.]
[Rewards: E-Rank Promotion.]
The quests varied widely in difficulty and reward, but one thing was clear.
Every single one of them offered some kind of rank promotion.
"I completed a C-Rank quest to get where I am now," Emilia said casually.
"Are there any B-Rank quests?" Leon asked immediately, his tone calm but direct, "If we can skip ahead, it would save time."
Emilia paused for a moment, clearly thinking.
"I think there is one..." she said slowly, "But no one really attempts it because it’s way too difficult."
Leon’s lips curled into a faint grin.
"Nothing’s too difficult for our group," he said simply, as if stating a fact, "Let’s check it out."
To find it, Leon approached a nearby player and asked about the B-Rank quest, but the reaction he received was far from encouraging.
"Are you insane?" the player snapped, looking at him like he had just said something ridiculous, "Nobody does that quest, it’s a complete waste of time."
Leon didn’t stop there. He asked a few more people, but the responses were all the same.
Some ignored him completely, others told him to go away, and a few just laughed at the idea.
After a while, Leon let out a small sigh.
"Nobody’s nice in this place," he muttered.
Emilia simply shrugged with a small smile.
"Doesn’t make it that different from the [Lower Domain]," she said, "That’s why I didn’t bother asking anyone either."
Instead of relying on others, the three of them decided to search for it themselves.
They walked deeper into the [Quest] hall, passing dozens of boards, until eventually, they reached the far end of the section.
And there... They saw it. A single board stood slightly apart from the others.
Unlike the rest, which glowed with a calm blue light, this one was crimson, its edges jagged and rough, almost as if it was warning anyone who approached it.
Above it, a large letter was displayed: "B."
It was clear from the lack of people around it that no one wanted anything to do with it.
Leon stepped forward without hesitation and began reading it out loud.
I spent a few Chapters making sure everything about [Higher Domain #3] was understood as it’s important for the future, I hope you guys didn’t mind it :)!

chapters.title: Chapter 186: B-Rank Quest, Kill the Volcano Crab King
paragraphs: [B-Rank Quest: Kill the "Volcano Crab King" in the hardest difficulty of the "Hellish Beach" realm and bring back the "Volcano Crab King Crystal"]
[Reward: B-Rank Promotion, 25 Skill Stones, 25 Enhancement Stones, Mythical Treasure Chest.]
Leon blinked once, then tilted his head slightly.
"I... don’t really see what’s so difficult about this," he said honestly, "There should be players strong enough to kill that thing, right?"
But when he turned around, he noticed something: Emilia’s expression had changed completely.
Her eyes were slightly widened, and her usual calm demeanor had shifted into something more serious.
"The [Volcano Crab King] only appears in the highest difficulty of the [Hellish Beach] realm," she said slowly, "And that realm is considered the hardest one in the entire [Newbie District]."
Leon nodded slightly, processing that information.
"I still think it’s doable," he replied calmly, "Except if..."
Before he could finish his sentence, the board suddenly flickered.
As if reacting to their conversation, the text changed.
[The drop rate of the "Volcano Crab King Crystal" is 0.2%.]
There was a brief silence.
"Oh wow," Leon muttered. That explained everything.
Even if someone managed to defeat the strongest boss in the [Newbie District], they would still only have a 0.2% chance of getting the required item. It was borderline impossible.
"I guess there’s no point in doing it then," Celeste said with a small sigh, her shoulders dropping slightly.
But the moment she said that, both Leon and Emilia slowly turned their heads toward her.
Their expressions were... strange. Almost amused.
"Did you not tell her about your talent?" Emilia asked with a smile, raising an eyebrow slightly, "You’re playing that same game with her?"
"No," Leon replied calmly, shaking his head, "She knows."
For a brief moment, Celeste looked confused.
Then... Her eyes widened, "OH SHIT!"
She slapped her forehead as realization hit her instantly.
With Leon in the team, that so-called impossible drop rate of 0.2%... didn’t matter at all. It might as well have been 100%.
As long as they defeated the boss, the item would drop. Guaranteed.
"The only problem is whether we can complete the quest together," Leon said, his tone returning to normal as he thought it through.
Once a quest was completed, it disappeared forever and was replaced by another after a while.
Since the trio planned to move forward fast, it would be inefficient to wait.
"We can register as a team," Emilia replied, "Though the rewards don’t increase, I’m fine with just getting the B-Rank promotion."
"M-Me too!" Celeste nodded quickly, "You can take everything else!"
Leon smiled faintly.
"Thanks," he said, "Though I only really care about the [Mythical Treasure Chest]."
Everything else was just a bonus.
And with that decision made, Leon stepped forward without hesitation and reached out toward the crimson board.
He selected the quest.
Ding!
[You have accepted the B-Rank Quest.]
[Party Members: Celestial, Saintess, UndyingPhoenix.]
The moment the new panel appeared before them, Leon’s eyes flickered slightly as he read through it carefully.
Beside him, Celeste leaned forward just a little, clearly excited, and Emilia simply crossed her arms with a satisfied smile.
The three of them were now officially registered as a team for the quest.
This meant that as long as they managed to complete it together, they would each receive their B-Rank promotion, along with whatever rewards were tied to the quest itself.

"I need more experience than anyone else anyway," Leon sighed as he glanced at his panel for a brief moment before closing it again, "So I would have ended up going into the hardest [Realm] no matter what if I wanted to level up properly."
His tone wasn’t complaining, though. If anything, it carried a faint hint of satisfaction.
Leon was genuinely glad that the [Will of Nature]’s curse had doubled his experience requirements.
Because while it made leveling slower, it also gave him more time to prepare, more opportunities to fight stronger enemies, and more chances to collect valuable drops.
And for someone like him... That mattered more than leveling quickly.
But at the same time, he wasn’t planning on slowing down either.
The amount of experience required for normal players was already high, and with the curse applied, it meant Leon would have to put in at least twice the effort, if not more, to keep up his pace.
Still... That didn’t change anything. He would just keep moving forward like always.
"Alright," Emilia said with a light smile as she stretched her arms slightly, clearly energized now that they had a goal, "Now that we’ve got the quest, let’s move on to the next section~"
"Realms?" Celeste asked immediately, her eyes lighting up with excitement, though she hesitated for a split second as another thought crossed her mind, "Or maybe we should..."
"I think we should check out the [Market] first," Emilia interrupted smoothly, "It’s actually really important here, way more than you’d expect.
Leon raised an eyebrow slightly at that, though he didn’t object.
The [Trading House] was still available, of course, and players could still sell their items there like usual.
But the [Market] inside the [Awakener Association] was different.
It offered items that couldn’t be found anywhere else.
And more importantly... The higher your rank, the better the items you could access.
"That probably makes this the [Higher Domain] where [Eternal Coins] matter the most," Leon said thoughtfully as they began walking away from the [Quests] section, "Interesting."
Emilia nodded without hesitation.
"Yeah, and some of the stuff there is ridiculously expensive," she added, "Like... way more than what you’d expect."
Leon didn’t seem too concerned about that though.
Instead, he casually glanced at his current balance.
[Eternal Coins: 516,470]
A faint grin appeared on his face.
With that amount of coins, he already had a strong advantage over most players in this domain.
And more importantly... If others had money to spend, then he had even more opportunities to earn.
"I’ll just keep selling items through the [Trading House] and stack more," Leon thought with a grin, "This place might actually be perfect for that."
Without wasting any more time, the trio exited the [Quests] section and returned to the main lobby of the [Awakener Association].
Players were constantly moving in and out, creating a steady flow of noise and activity that never seemed to stop.
From there, they followed one of the main paths leading toward the [Market] section.
As they walked, Celeste couldn’t help but look around with curiosity, her eyes scanning the architecture, the design, and the overall structure of the place.
"Who do you think even built all of this?" she asked, her voice filled with genuine curiosity, "It doesn’t feel like something that just appeared out of nowhere."
Leon shrugged lightly.
"Could be the [Heavenly One], or maybe the natives of this domain," he replied casually, "Honestly, you could ask that question about almost every domain we’ve seen so far."
"...Yeah, I guess," Celeste muttered as she scratched her chin slightly, though her curiosity didn’t completely fade.
Eventually, they entered another large hallway, and after walking for a short while, they finally emerged into a completely different section of the building.

Leon blinked once, then tilted his head slightly.

But when he turned around, he noticed something: Emilia’s expression had changed completely.
Her eyes were slightly widened, and her usual calm demeanor had shifted into something more serious.
"The [Volcano Crab King] only appears in the highest difficulty of the [Hellish Beach] realm," she said slowly, "And that realm is considered the hardest one in the entire [Newbie District]."
Leon nodded slightly, processing that information.
"I still think it’s doable," he replied calmly, "Except if..."
Before he could finish his sentence, the board suddenly flickered.
As if reacting to their conversation, the text changed.
[The drop rate of the "Volcano Crab King Crystal" is 0.2%.]
There was a brief silence.
"Oh wow," Leon muttered.
That explained everything.
Even if someone managed to defeat the strongest boss in the [Newbie District], they would still only have a 0.2% chance of getting the required item.
It was borderline impossible.
"I guess there’s no point in doing it then," Celeste said with a small sigh, her shoulders dropping slightly.
But the moment she said that, both Leon and Emilia slowly turned their heads toward her.
Their expressions were... strange.
Almost amused.
"Did you not tell her about your talent?" Emilia asked with a smile, raising an eyebrow slightly, "You’re playing that same game with her?"
"No," Leon replied calmly, shaking his head, "She knows."
For a brief moment, Celeste looked confused.
Then...
Her eyes widened, "OH SHIT!"
She slapped her forehead as realization hit her instantly.
With Leon in the team, that so-called impossible drop rate of 0.2%... didn’t matter at all.
It might as well have been 100%.
As long as they defeated the boss, the item would drop.
Guaranteed.
"The only problem is whether we can complete the quest together," Leon said, his tone returning to normal as he thought it through.
Once a quest was completed, it disappeared forever and was replaced by another after a while.
Since the trio planned to move forward fast, it would be inefficient to wait.
"We can register as a team," Emilia replied, "Though the rewards don’t increase, I’m fine with just getting the B-Rank promotion."
"M-Me too!" Celeste nodded quickly, "You can take everything else!"
Leon smiled faintly.
"Thanks," he said, "Though I only really care about the [Mythical Treasure Chest]."
Everything else was just a bonus.
And with that decision made, Leon stepped forward without hesitation and reached out toward the crimson board.
He selected the quest.
Ding!
[You have accepted the B-Rank Quest.]
[Party Members: Celestial, Saintess, UndyingPhoenix.]
The moment the new panel appeared before them, Leon’s eyes flickered slightly as he read through it carefully.
Beside him, Celeste leaned forward just a little, clearly excited, and Emilia simply crossed her arms with a satisfied smile.
The three of them were now officially registered as a team for the quest.
This meant that as long as they managed to complete it together, they would each receive their B-Rank promotion, along with whatever rewards were tied to the quest itself.

"I need more experience than anyone else anyway," Leon sighed as he glanced at his panel for a brief moment before closing it again, "So I would have ended up going into the hardest [Realm] no matter what if I wanted to level up properly."
His tone wasn’t complaining, though.
If anything, it carried a faint hint of satisfaction.
Leon was genuinely glad that the [Will of Nature]’s curse had doubled his experience requirements.
Because while it made leveling slower, it also gave him more time to prepare, more opportunities to fight stronger enemies, and more chances to collect valuable drops.
And for someone like him...
That mattered more than leveling quickly.
But at the same time, he wasn’t planning on slowing down either.
The amount of experience required for normal players was already high, and with the curse applied, it meant Leon would have to put in at least twice the effort, if not more, to keep up his pace.
Still...
That didn’t change anything.
He would just keep moving forward like always.
"Alright," Emilia said with a light smile as she stretched her arms slightly, clearly energized now that they had a goal, "Now that we’ve got the quest, let’s move on to the next section~"
"Realms?" Celeste asked immediately, her eyes lighting up with excitement, though she hesitated for a split second as another thought crossed her mind, "Or maybe we should..."
"I think we should check out the [Market] first," Emilia interrupted smoothly, "It’s actually really important here, way more than you’d expect.
Leon raised an eyebrow slightly at that, though he didn’t object.
The [Trading House] was still available, of course, and players could still sell their items there like usual.
But the [Market] inside the [Awakener Association] was different.
It offered items that couldn’t be found anywhere else.
And more importantly...
The higher your rank, the better the items you could access.
"That probably makes this the [Higher Domain] where [Eternal Coins] matter the most," Leon said thoughtfully as they began walking away from the [Quests] section, "Interesting."
Emilia nodded without hesitation.
"Yeah, and some of the stuff there is ridiculously expensive," she added, "Like... way more than what you’d expect."
Leon didn’t seem too concerned about that though.
Instead, he casually glanced at his current balance.
[Eternal Coins: 516,470]
A faint grin appeared on his face.
With that amount of coins, he already had a strong advantage over most players in this domain.
And more importantly...
If others had money to spend, then he had even more opportunities to earn.
"I’ll just keep selling items through the [Trading House] and stack more," Leon thought with a grin, "This place might actually be perfect for that."
Without wasting any more time, the trio exited the [Quests] section and returned to the main lobby of the [Awakener Association].
Players were constantly moving in and out, creating a steady flow of noise and activity that never seemed to stop.
From there, they followed one of the main paths leading toward the [Market] section.
As they walked, Celeste couldn’t help but look around with curiosity, her eyes scanning the architecture, the design, and the overall structure of the place.
"Who do you think even built all of this?" she asked, her voice filled with genuine curiosity, "It doesn’t feel like something that just appeared out of nowhere."
Leon shrugged lightly.
"Could be the [Heavenly One], or maybe the natives of this domain," he replied casually, "Honestly, you could ask that question about almost every domain we’ve seen so far."
"...Yeah, I guess," Celeste muttered as she scratched her chin slightly, though her curiosity didn’t completely fade.
Eventually, they entered another large hallway, and after walking for a short while, they finally emerged into a completely different section of the building.

chapters.title: Chapter 187: Market Section, To The Hellish Beach Realm
paragraphs: Ding!
[Welcome to the "Market" section of the "Awakener Association"]
[You can head into halls at or below your rank, improve it if you wish to acquire the better items!]
The space before them opened up into several massive halls, each one labeled clearly with a rank: F-Rank, E-Rank, D-Rank, C-Rank.
And finally... B-Rank.
The difference in activity between them was obvious.
The F-Rank and E-Rank halls were filled with players, while the higher-ranked halls gradually became quieter.
And the B-Rank hall? Completely empty. Not a single person was inside.
"I can enter up to C-Rank," Emilia said as she casually walked forward toward the higher-ranked section.
Fwoosh!
A transparent veil shimmered briefly as she passed through it without any resistance.
Leon stepped forward right after her, curious to see if he could do the same.
But the moment he reached the barrier—
Bump!
He was stopped instantly. A faint force pushed him back slightly, and a panel appeared before him.
[You are currently F-Rank, please improve your rank first.]
[Any further attempts will result in "punishment"]
Leon raised an eyebrow slightly as he read that.
"Punishment?" he muttered, clearly intrigued.
"I don’t know what it is," Emilia said as she stepped back out of the C-Rank section, shaking her head slightly.
"Damn," Leon muttered, though there was a faint hint of curiosity still lingering in his expression.
For a brief moment, it almost looked like he was considering testing it anyway.
But in the end... He simply shook his head.
"Alright," he said with a small smile, "We’ll check out the higher-ranked items after we complete the quest."
He glanced toward the empty B-Rank hall one last time before turning away.
"For now... let’s focus on clearing that quest."
Hearing that, both Emilia and Celeste nodded without hesitation.
Because unlike the others in this place... They actually had a real chance of completing it.
And without wasting another second, the three of them turned and began heading toward the [Realms] section.
Leon, Celeste and Emilia left the [Market] section without wasting any more time.
All three of them silently agreed that they would come back once they reached B-Rank, as there was clearly much more to explore there.

Especially with the higher-tier halls locked behind rank restrictions, and considering the amount of [Eternal Coins] Leon currently had, there was no doubt that the [Market] would become extremely valuable in the near future.
’The items in the [Advanced District] and [Awakener District] should be very good too,’ Leon’s eyes glinted.
Right after that, they followed the path that led deeper into the [Awakener Association], heading straight toward the [Realms] section.
And once they stepped inside...
"Yeah... this is definitely the busiest place," Leon muttered as his eyes scanned the area.
The chamber in front of them was absolutely massive, far larger than any of the previous sections they had seen.
It was completely filled with players, easily tens of thousands of them moving around, simply preparing themselves before entering one of the [Realms].
The sheer scale of it made Celeste pause for a moment as she looked around, her eyes widening slightly.
"There’s... so many people," she said quietly, clearly a bit overwhelmed by the atmosphere.
"That’s because this is where everything happens," Emilia replied calmly as she continued walking forward, clearly more used to this environment after spending some time here already.
In the center of the chamber, six large pathways stretched outward, each one leading to a different [Realm].
Above each path, glowing text hovered in the air, clearly indicating their destinations: [Snowy Mountain], [Enchanted Forest], [Shadow March]...
Each path had a steady flow of players going in and out, some returning injured, others leaving with determination in their eyes.
But among all of them... One path stood out.
It was the one furthest from the entrance, almost isolated compared to the others, and most importantly, it had the least amount of players near it.
Above it, the glowing text read: [Hellish Beach].
"Here it is," Leon said as a small grin formed on his face, already walking toward it without hesitation.
Celeste and Emilia exchanged a quick glance before following right behind him.
As they got closer, the atmosphere subtly shifted.
There were still players nearby, but unlike the other paths, no one seemed eager to enter this one.
It was clear that this realm had a reputation.
But just as the trio was about to enter the hall leading to it...
"Hold on."
A voice suddenly stopped them.
Leon immediately turned his head, his eyes landing on a man wearing a long robe, standing calmly a few meters away from them.
The robe itself was simple, but there was one detail that stood out immediately.
A golden insignia shaped like a vortex, with the letter "A" embedded within it.
Leon frowned slightly, not recognizing it. But before he could say anything...
"That’s the symbol of the [Awakener Association]," Emilia whispered quietly, stepping slightly closer to him, "It means he’s a native."
"Oh."
That explained it.
The man slowly approached them, his gaze calm but observant as he looked at each of them one by one.
"I have noticed that both your ranks and levels are... fairly low," he said in a composed tone, "It is not advised to enter the [Hellish Beach] in your current state."
His voice wasn’t aggressive, nor was it mocking.

Natives in this domain also had access to the player’s information including their [Awakener Panels], which meant that he could clearly see that Leon and Celeste were only F-Rank, while Emilia was C-Rank.
To him, this probably looked like a group walking straight into danger without understanding what they were doing.
"And that quest..." the man continued, his gaze narrowing slightly as if recalling something unpleasant, "It is not advised to—"
"We’ll be fine."
Leon cut him off without hesitation, his tone neutral but firm as he continued walking forward.
The man paused for a moment, watching Leon’s back as he walked away, then simply nodded slightly.
"Alright." He didn’t try to stop them again.
Instead, he returned to his position, his eyes shifting toward the other players in the area, ready to assist anyone else who might need guidance.
Meanwhile, Leon, Celeste and Emilia continued forward, stepping into the hall marked with the [Hellish Beach] text above it.
The further they walked, the quieter it became.
The noise from the main chamber slowly faded behind them, replaced by a more focused, tense atmosphere.
And eventually...
"Here it is," Emilia said with a small smile, gesturing forward.
At the end of the hall, inside a smaller chamber, stood the portal.
The room itself already reflected the nature of the realm.
The ground was covered in fine sand, warm under their feet, and the air had a slightly humid, tropical feel to it.
And in the center of the room...
A massive swirling portal hovered, its beige color rotating slowly, the energy within it distorting the air around it.
There were a few players inside the room as well, but none of them were entering yet.
Leon didn’t even glance at them.

"I’ve mainly been in the [Enchanted Forest] these past few days," Emilia explained as she stood beside him, "So I understand how [Realms] work, but this one might be completely different, especially at higher difficulty, so be careful."
"Got it," Celeste nodded, her expression turning slightly more serious now.
Leon simply nodded as well, his attention already fully on the portal.
He stepped forward. And the moment he did...
Ding!
[Select the "Hellish Beach" realm’s difficulty:]
[Hell] [Nightmare]
Leon raised an eyebrow slightly.
"Damn," he muttered, "No wonder people say it’s hard."

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Entering the Hellish Beach Realm, Nightmare Difficulty
paragraphs: Unlike zones, where difficulty changes mainly affected strength and numbers, [Realms] were different.
A higher difficulty could completely alter the environment, introduce new mechanics, spawn entirely different creatures, and even change the structure of the realm itself.
Which meant that the gap between [Hell] and [Nightmare] was massive.
"Well..." Leon said as a grin slowly spread across his face, "We don’t really have a choice, do we?"
The quest clearly stated that the [Volcano Crab King] only appeared in the highest difficulty.
So there was no point in hesitating. Without giving anyone time to react...
Fwoosh!
Leon selected [Nightmare].
And the moment he did—
BOOM!
The portal reacted instantly.
The calm beige color twisted violently as a deep crimson hue spread through it, the energy intensifying to the point where the entire room seemed to vibrate slightly.
The atmosphere changed in an instant.
Everyone in the room turned their heads at the same time, their eyes locking onto the portal.
"Holy hell... they’re actually choosing [Nightmare]?"
"Are they insane? I heard it can take days just to navigate that place..."
"Look at their ranks... two F-Rank and one C-Rank, they’re dead."
Murmurs spread quickly. But then... Something else caught their attention.
Their eyes shifted toward Leon. And more specifically... His ID.
"CELESTIAL?!"
"HOLY SHIT!"
The reaction was instant.
"Let’s move," Leon said with a grin, not bothering to waste another second as he stepped forward and jumped straight into the portal.
Celeste and Emilia followed right behind him without hesitation.
A few players instinctively took a step forward, tempted to follow.
After all, if it was really him... But then they looked back at the portal.
They stared at the crimson energy swirling within it, and the [Nightmare] difficulty.
"...Yeah, no. I’m not going in there."
"If it was [Hell], maybe..."
"Let’s just wait and see what happens."
And just like that, the idea died. No one followed.
Instead, they chose to stay behind, watching, waiting, curious to see whether the so-called [Celestial] could actually conquer something like this.
Meanwhile, inside the portal...
Leon felt his body being pulled apart and reassembled at the same time, the space around him twisting violently as he was transported into the [Hellish Beach].
The sensation lasted only a few seconds. But it was enough.
Fwoosh!
Leon landed. His feet sank slightly into warm sand as the sound of waves crashing echoed in the distance.
He slowly lifted his gaze. Behind him, a dense forest stretched outward, its trees dark and twisted.
And far ahead... A massive volcano towered over the entire landscape, smoke rising from its peak as faint red light pulsed from within.
’I guess that’s where the boss is,’ Leon thought with a small grin forming on his lips.
He turned around, already speaking.
"Emilia, Celeste, do you guys see this—"
But he suddenly stopped as he realized that he was the only one around.
Neither Celeste nor Emilia were close to him at this moment.
"Oh," Leon let out quietly.
It seemed... They hadn’t been sent to the same spawn point.
Since [Realms] were much larger than [Zones], they didn’t function the same way when it came to entry points.
Instead of sending every player to a fixed location, they were designed with multiple spawn points scattered across the entire map.
Making exploration more unpredictable and forcing players to adapt rather than rely on coordination from the very start.
That also meant that even if a group entered together, or even if someone followed right behind another person, there was no guarantee they would appear anywhere close to each other.
In fact, more often than not, they wouldn’t.
’I guess I’ll have to find them myself,’ Leon thought calmly as he began to move forward, not showing any sign of concern despite the situation.
To him, this wasn’t really a problem.

Even though the name of the realm was [Hellish Beach], Leon quickly realized that the beach itself was only a small portion of the entire area, most likely serving as an outer layer or starting zone for players entering the realm.
The real challenge clearly lay deeper within.

The island itself stretched far beyond the sandy shore, and the massive forest ahead seemed to be the true beginning of the journey, acting as the main path players would have to cross before even getting close to the volcano.
To Leon, none of this really changed his approach.
Whether it took hours or days didn’t matter to him.
As long as he could complete the quest, that was enough.
Even if it meant spending multiple days inside this realm, grinding enemies, collecting drops, and slowly making his way forward, he was completely fine with it.
In fact, part of him even welcomed it.
After all, he still needed to level up, and more importantly, he needed items.
And this place... It was perfect for that.
Not to mention, he still had to wait for the cooldown of his [Life Vessel] title to reset, which meant that staying here for a while wasn’t a bad idea at all.
But just as he was about to step into the forest... Leon suddenly stopped.
His expression shifted slightly.
’Actually... I just thought of something.’
Searching for Celeste and Emilia blindly across an entire island wasn’t exactly efficient, especially considering how large this realm seemed to be.
And even if they all moved toward the volcano, there was no guarantee they would meet quickly.
And while that wasn’t a major issue... It was still annoying.
He had already received messages from both of them, likely asking about his location or checking if he was alright.
But instead of replying immediately, Leon decided to try something else.
Something that might make things much easier.
"World Map."
The moment he said it, a familiar panel appeared before his eyes, expanding outward and displaying a large, detailed interface.
This was the first time he was using the [World Map] inside a [Realm] or [Zone], and he wasn’t entirely sure how it would behave.
But... If it worked the way he hoped... Then things would become much simpler.
And a second later, the map appeared. Leon’s eyes lit up slightly as he looked at it.
The entire [Hellish Beach] island was displayed before him, meaning that the [World Map] indeed worked on it!
Though not everything was visible: large portions of the map were covered in a grey fog, clearly indicating unexplored areas.
Which meant that the system only revealed locations that the player had either visited or had visual access to.
Still... That was more than enough. Because now, Leon could clearly see his own position.
A small marker representing him was placed right on the beach, exactly where he was standing.
And ahead of him was the forest.
But more importantly... At the center of the island, the volcano stood out clearly on the map, marked with a distinct symbol: a skull.
’I guess it’s showing me where the boss is too,’ Leon thought with a grin, clearly satisfied.
But that wasn’t even the best part. Because just a moment later, he noticed two small dots moving.
"They’re here," Leon muttered under his breath.
Celeste and Emilia. Each of them was visible on the map.
But they weren’t close. Not even slightly.
They had been spawned on completely different sides of the island, far apart from each other, which only confirmed just how large this realm truly was.
Still, that didn’t matter anymore. Because now, Leon knew exactly where they were.
And more importantly... They knew where to go.
Without wasting any time, Leon opened his messages and quickly sent one to both of them.
[Celestial: I can see you on the "World Map", just do whatever you want, I’ll find you eventually.]
The reply came almost instantly.
[Saintess: Alright ٩(◕‿◕)۶]
[UndyingPhoenix: I’ll be waiting for you!]
Leon smiled faintly as he closed the panel.
Everything was under control. There was no need to rush.
They could all move at their own pace, grow stronger, and eventually meet up somewhere along the way.
And with that... Leon finally stepped forward.
The sand beneath his feet shifted slightly as he moved, the sound of the waves slowly fading behind him as he approached the edge of the forest.
Leon’s grin slowly returned.
"Let’s see what this [Hellish Beach] is really about."
And with that, he stepped into the forest.
