One after another, the leftover [Pyroman Apes] and [Fire Hobgoblins] fell under Leon’s attacks, unable to keep up with the constant pressure of his spells and sword strikes.
Their numbers rapidly decreasing until there was nothing left standing in the clearing except for a single figure: the [Hellish Hobgoblin].
The boss slowly straightened its posture, its massive body still covered in wounds from Leon’s previous attacks.
Yet despite that, it lifted its flaming bat once more, its breathing heavy but steady enough to continue the fight.
Then, without warning—
Fwoosh!
It swung its weapon down with full force, aiming directly at Leon’s head.
Leon reacted instantly.

He raised his sword sideways, positioning it carefully to deflect the incoming strike rather than trying to tank it head-on, knowing very well that meeting that kind of raw power directly would be a mistake.
But the moment the two weapons collided—
BOOM!

A powerful shockwave spread through the clearing as the impact echoed loudly, and even though Leon managed to block the attack, the force behind it was far greater than he anticipated, forcing his body downward slightly as his feet dug into the scorched ground beneath him.
’Tch...’ Leon narrowed his eyes slightly as he held his ground, ’The double strength blessing doesn’t apply here... it only works when I’m attacking...’
That realization was annoying, but not unexpected.
If he wanted to take full advantage of his strength multiplier, he needed to be on the offensive, and right now, the boss was forcing him into a defensive position.
Before Leon could even adjust—
Fwoosh!
The [Hellish Hobgoblin] lifted its bat again and brought it down once more.
BOOM!
Another impact.
Then again.
Fwoosh!
BOOM!
And again.
The cycle repeated itself rapidly, the boss relentlessly attacking without giving Leon any time to breathe, each swing carrying enough power to crack the ground beneath them.
It was clear what it was trying to do: force Leon into a mistake and overwhelm him through sheer pressure.
But despite the intensity of the attacks, Leon didn’t panic.

He held his ground, carefully adjusting his stance with each impact, his muscles tightening as he absorbed the force and redirected it as best as he could, waiting for the right moment to strike back.
He knew that he couldn’t keep this up forever.
At some point, he would need to counterattack, even if it meant taking a hit in the process.

’I might have to drop the [Darkness Barrier] and just trade damage,’ Leon thought as he prepared himself mentally, his grip on his sword tightening slightly, ’As long as I can land a clean hit, this fight is over.’
He was ready to commit.
But right as he was about to move—
Fwoosh!
A sudden blur cut through the air from beyond the clearing.
"GARGHHHHH!"
The [Hellish Hobgoblin] suddenly let out a roar of pain, its body jerking slightly as something struck it from the side.
Leon’s eyes widened as he instinctively looked up.
And what he saw immediately made him understand: Celeste.
She had arrived.
Her figure was suspended mid-air, her [Phoenix Wings] spread wide behind her, glowing with a fiery brilliance that made her stand out against the burning environment around them.
The wings themselves were majestic, far larger than Pyra’s, yet clearly sharing the same origin.
Flames were dancing along their edges as they carried her effortlessly through the air.
Without hesitation, Celeste had used her speed and momentum to drive her spear directly into the side of the boss’s neck, managing to pierce through its defenses just enough to draw blood.
Of course, the attack wasn’t nearly strong enough to kill it.
Her [Combat Power] was still lower than the boss’s, and this kind of enemy couldn’t be taken down in a single strike by her alone.
But that didn’t matter.
Because the moment she created that opening, it was already over.
While the [Hellish Hobgoblin] turned its attention toward Celeste, momentarily distracted by the unexpected attack, Leon didn’t waste even a fraction of a second.
Fwoosh!
He dashed forward instantly, closing the distance between them in the blink of an eye.
Crescent Slash!
Energy gathered at the tip of his blade as he swung it forward, releasing a sharp crescent-shaped attack that forced the boss to react.
Instinctively, the [Hellish Hobgoblin] raised its bat to block.
Exactly what Leon wanted.
Because at that exact moment—
"Die."
Leon was already right in front of it.
SLASH!
His sword moved in a clean, precise arc.
The blade cut through the air... and then through the boss’s neck without resistance.
For a brief second, everything went silent.
Then—
Thud!
The massive body of the [Hellish Hobgoblin] collapsed to the ground, its head separated cleanly, its life extinguished instantly.
Ding!
[You have killed x40 "Pyroman Apes" and gained 1,300,000 experience points.]
[You have killed x49 "Fire Hobgoblin" and gained 1,960,000 experience points.]
[You have killed "Hellish Hobgoblin (Boss)" and gained 800,000 experience points.]
[100% Drop Rate has triggered...]
"Nice," Leon muttered with a small, satisfied smile as he lowered his sword slightly.
But right after—
Beep!
[Unfortunately, your "Storage Space" is full so the remaining items will drop on the corpses.]
"Yeah...
I expected that," Leon sighed lightly.
With only 160 slots available in his [Storage Space], and many of them already occupied, it was obvious that defeating nearly a hundred monsters at once would exceed his capacity.
All around him, glowing items began to appear, scattered across the battlefield, shining brightly as they remained on the ground instead of being automatically stored.
Meanwhile, Celeste slowly descended from the air, her wings fading away as she landed in front of him, a small but satisfied smile on her face.
But the moment Leon looked at her properly, his expression changed: there was blood on her side.
"Oh shit," Leon said immediately as he stepped forward, his eyes narrowing slightly as he focused on the injury, "What happened?"
"I got clipped by one of the [Fire Hobgoblins] earlier," Celeste replied with a light smile, clearly trying to downplay it, "It’s nothing serious... my phoenix flames will heal it eventually."
Leon didn’t respond right away.
He simply looked at the wound for a few seconds, making sure it wasn’t anything critical, before finally nodding.
"Alright... just be careful," he said calmly, before shifting the topic, "By the way, how did you even find me?"
Celeste tilted her head slightly before answering.
"The monsters I was fighting suddenly stopped and rushed in this direction," she explained, "So I figured something big was happening here and followed them...
I guess that worked out pretty well."
"Damn," Leon muttered.
That probably meant Emilia might also be heading this way.
But for now, Leon turned his attention back to the battlefield.

It took him around ten full minutes to gather everything, moving from corpse to corpse, collecting the items that had dropped and placing them all together in one spot to properly evaluate what he had gained.
And when he finally finished, even he paused for a second.
I didn’t forget about the experience points or [Celestial Hand], it’s next Chapter.

chapters.title: Chapter 195: The Hellish Horde’s Loot [1]
paragraphs: After gathering every single item that had dropped from the battlefield, Leon finally allowed himself a moment to slow down and carefully examine everything laid out in front of him.
His eyes scanned through the long list of rewards with a calm but clearly satisfied expression.
[Pyroman Ape Essence x40: Consuming will increase Agility by 8 and Spirit by 10.]
[Fire Hobgoblin Essence x49: Consuming will increase Strength by 15.]
[Hellish Hobgoblin Essence: Consuming will increase Strength by 100, Agility by 50.]
[Sub-Talent Scrolls: x89 Flame Affinity (C-Level), Deep Flame Affinity (B-Level), Super Strength Enhancement (B-Level)]
[Pyroman Ape Fur x40 (Rare)]
[Hell Bat (Legendary): +10,000 Attack Power, +5,000 Strength, +3,000 Agility. Constantly emits out fire that will scorch an opponent hit. Requirement: Deep Flame Affinity (B-Level)]
[Skill Book: Hellish Swing (Legendary)]
Leon let out a slow breath as he finished reading through everything, slightly tilting his head while processing the sheer quantity and quality of the loot he had just obtained.
Because even for someone like him, who was already used to gaining absurd rewards thanks to his abilities, this was still far beyond what could normally be expected from a single battle.
"Damn..." Leon muttered under his breath.
Right next to him, Celeste was staring at the pile of items with wide eyes, her expression showing pure disbelief as she tried to wrap her head around what she was seeing.
"What the hell..." she said slowly, her voice filled with shock, "Even if I somehow managed to kill all of those monsters by myself, I would’ve maybe gotten a few essences at best... and that’s it."
She wasn’t exaggerating in the slightest.
Because for a normal player, the drop rates in a place like this were extremely unforgiving, especially when it came to anything beyond basic materials or low-tier rewards.
And the idea of obtaining dozens of sub-talent scrolls, let alone legendary equipment, from a single encounter was something most players wouldn’t even dream of.
And yet, all of it was sitting right there in front of Leon.
Naturally, he couldn’t help but smile slightly as he looked at everything.
But before he could even begin sorting through it properly, something else happened.
Ding!
["Celestial Hand" has activated.]
Leon blinked once, then nodded as he immediately understood what was happening.
"Oh, right," he said casually, a small grin forming on his face, "I guess that’s gonna be a bonus."

The passive ability activated multiple times in quick succession, each trigger giving him the opportunity to extract something additional from the defeated enemies, and without hesitation, Leon chose the most valuable option every single time: sub-talent scrolls.
By the time the effect finished activating, the numbers had increased noticeably.
[Sub-Talent Scrolls: x102 Flame Affinity (C-Level), x2 Deep Flame Affinity (B-Level), Super Strength Enhancement (B-Level)]
Leon stared at the updated count for a moment, his eyes narrowing slightly as he realized just how absurd this was.
Having over a hundred sub-talent scrolls at once wasn’t just rare, it was practically unheard of for an individual player.
Even large guilds or organized groups would struggle to gather that many without spending massive amounts of resources.
And from a financial perspective alone, this haul was ridiculous.

Each [Flame Affinity (C-Level)] scroll could easily sell for around 20,000 [Eternal Coins], while the [Deep Flame Affinity (B-Level)] scrolls could go as high as 50,000 or even more depending on demand.
Which meant that if Leon decided to sell everything right now, he could instantly make a fortune.
The players in the [Auction House] would rush to buy these the moment they appeared, especially those who specialized in spells, since even a single sub-talent could significantly boost their power.
But despite understanding all of that... Leon didn’t seem particularly interested in the money.
To him, [Eternal Coins] were useful, yes, especially in a place like [Higher Domain #3], but at the same time, it wasn’t something he felt pressured about.
He knew he could always farm more. He could always sell more items. There was no real urgency.

Instead, his attention slowly shifted toward Celeste, who was now sitting on the ground nearby, gently holding Pyra in her arms after summoning her from the [Pet Space], her expression soft as she carefully patted the small phoenix.
Leon watched that scene for a few seconds in silence.
And then... he made up his mind.
Helping his companions grow stronger mattered far more than stacking currency.

Pyra was already level 6, which meant she was only four levels away from reaching level 10 and triggering her first evolution, something Leon knew would drastically increase her power and unlock new abilities that could change the flow of future battles.
He knew that Pyra would be a genuine powerhouse in the future.

As for Celeste herself, she had already reached level 69 after fighting her own battles earlier, even though she didn’t receive the experience points from the boss due to the system’s contribution rules.
Still, she was progressing steadily.
And as for Leon...
Ding!
[Congratulations, you have leveled up to Level 67 + Level 68 + Level 69 + ... + Level 72!]
[Due to "Heaven’s Blessing", you have gained 2,700 points in all attributes and 2,700 free points to distribute.]
Leon let out a quiet breath as he saw the notifications stack one after another, the numbers climbing rapidly before finally stopping.
"Damn..." he muttered, shaking his head slightly.
Under normal circumstances, after defeating that many high-level enemies at once, especially ones stronger than himself, he would have likely reached level 75.
But the [Will of Nature]’s curse was still affecting his experience gain, forcing him to require significantly more points to level up.
Still... Leon didn’t seem bothered. If anything, he looked slightly amused.
"I wish the [Will of Nature] could curse me again," he said with a faint smile.
He thought about that idea for a few seconds, but eventually, he decided to move on.
There was no need to overcomplicate things right now. He still had a quest to complete.
And after that... There were bigger challenges waiting for him.
Beep!
[You have 10,700 Free Points to Allocate!]
"I know," Leon said casually as he dismissed the notification without even looking at it in detail, clearly not in a hurry to distribute those points.
Instead, he turned his full attention back to the items in front of him.
More specifically... The sub-talent scrolls.
With over a hundred of them available, Leon had more than enough attempts to push for higher-tier results through fusion, and without wasting any more time, he immediately got to work.
Fwoosh! Beep!
[Fusion failed.]
Leon didn’t react.
Ding!
[Fusion successful.]
"Nice," he said simply, his tone calm.
From the side, Celeste watched him carefully, quickly realizing what he was doing as she saw scroll after scroll disappear and new ones appear in their place.
Beep! Ding! Beep! Ding!
The process continued at a steady pace, Leon maintaining full focus as he fused the sub-talents repeatedly, aiming for higher and higher levels without showing any sign of hesitation.
Failures didn’t bother him. Successes didn’t excite him too much either. He just kept going.
And eventually... After using a significant portion of the scrolls...
Leon finally stopped. He let out a small breath, then looked at the results.
"Phew... I guess it worked out."
[Sub-Talent Scrolls: x2 Ultimate Flame Control (S-Level), Absolute Flame Control (A-Level), Super Strength Enhancement (B-Level)]
For a brief moment, even Leon remained silent.
Because even with his expectations... This was a ridiculous outcome.
He had managed to obtain not just one, but two S-Level sub-talents.

chapters.title: Chapter 196: The Hellish Horde’s Loot [2], Finding Emilia
paragraphs: Once Leon had finished fusing all of his sub-talent scrolls and reached a result he was more than satisfied with, he didn’t waste any time standing around admiring it.
Because for him, power only mattered when it was actually put to use, and without hesitation, he picked up two of the scrolls and casually tossed them toward Celeste.
Celeste reacted quickly and caught them both without any trouble.
But the moment her eyes landed on the contents of the scrolls, her entire expression froze as her brain took a second to process what she was seeing.
Written clearly in front of her were words that completely changed everything.
"Holy shit..." Celeste muttered, her mouth hanging slightly open as she looked back up at Leon, clearly stunned, "Are you serious?"
Leon simply shrugged, his tone calm and almost indifferent as if he didn’t think it was a big deal.
"[Master of Elements] already pushes my fire affinity to SS-Level," he explained casually, "so I don’t really need it, I’ll be fine without it."
That was the truth, because for Leon, he couldn’t really stack it anymore than he already had.
While for Celeste, who specialized heavily in fire-based attacks, the difference would be massive.
In fact, Leon had briefly considered trying to fuse the two S-Level sub-talents together in an attempt to reach an even higher tier.
But the moment that thought crossed his mind, he immediately dismissed it.

He knew very well that the chances of failure were absurdly high, likely close to ninety-eight percent, and there was no reason to risk losing something this valuable for a gamble that probably wouldn’t pay off.
It was better to secure guaranteed power than chase something uncertain.
The [Enhancement Frenzy Liquid (Ancient)] he had could have secured his chances, but even then, Leon chose not to use it.
He knew there would be far better situations in the future where using such a rare item would bring even greater benefits.
So instead, he simply handed the scrolls over and let Celeste make use of them.
Without wasting another second, Celeste immediately poured her mana into both scrolls, her expression turning serious as she focused, and almost instantly...
Ding! Ding!
[Congratulations, you have learned the S-Level Sub-Talent: "Ultimate Flame Control"]
[You have evolved "Strength Enhancement (D-Level)" to "Super Strength Enhancement (B-Level)"]
The change was immediate. Celeste’s body trembled slightly as a surge of power flowed through her.
Her flames reacted to the new sub-talent as if they had been given a new level of life, becoming sharper, hotter, and far more controlled than before.
While at the same time, her physical strength increased significantly thanks to the evolution of her strength-based sub-talent.
Since most of her attacks were already centered around fire, this upgrade didn’t just improve her slightly, it multiplied her effectiveness to a completely different level.
Her [Combat Power] rose rapidly, climbing to nearly 460,000 in just a few seconds.
Celeste slowly looked down at her hands as faint flames danced around her fingers, her eyes shining with excitement as she felt the difference.
"Wow..." she said quietly, clearly amazed, "I don’t think I could have ever reached this level by myself."
Her flames were no longer just powerful, they were refined, controlled, and far more efficient, allowing her to produce stronger effects.
Leon watched her reaction with a small smile.
"Good," he said simply, "but that’s still nothing compared to what we need to reach."
Hearing that, Celeste nodded without hesitation.
She already understood that Leon’s goals were far beyond just surviving in this domain, he was aiming for something much bigger, and she had no intention of falling behind.
Leon then turned his attention back to the rest of the items scattered on the ground, his expression shifting slightly as he prepared to go through the next step.
Without hesitation, he began consuming the essences one after another.
Nom! Ding! Nom! Ding!
The notifications quickly followed.
[+290 Agility, +300 Spirit, +700 Strength]
"Nice," Leon nodded, clearly satisfied with the results.
Still, he didn’t keep everything for himself.
He deliberately set aside ten [Pyroman Ape Essences] and nine [Fire Hobgoblin Essences], knowing exactly who they were meant for.
He handed all of the [Fire Hobgoblin Essences] to Celeste, since they provided a direct boost to strength, something that perfectly matched her combat style with the spear.
While the remaining essences were reserved for Emilia, who would benefit from them once they regrouped.
After that, Leon moved on to the [Pyroman Ape Fur x40 (Rare)] items, preparing to enhance them through fusion, his focus returning as he carefully went through the process step by step.
The fusions took some time, but by the end of it, the results were more than worth it.
Fwoosh!
(Max) [Pyroman Ape Fur +4 (Rare): +2,800 Constitution, +1,700 Spirit. High resistance to fire-related attacks.]
Leon had successfully pushed three of them to the maximum level.
Without hesitation, he equipped the first one around his own neck, feeling the immediate increase in durability and resistance as the fur settled comfortably.
Then he handed the second one to Celeste, who accepted it with a smile, while the third was, once again, reserved for Emilia.
"Sorting through all of this actually takes longer than the fight itself," Celeste said with a small laugh as she adjusted the fur around her neck.
"Yeah," Leon replied with a nod, "but in the end, it’s always worth it, since it makes us stronger."
At this point, only two major items remained.
The [Hell Bat (Legendary)] and the [Skill Book: Hellish Swing (Legendary)].
Celeste picked up the weapon and examined it for a moment, clearly impressed by its stats, but after a few seconds, she shook her head slightly.
"It’s definitely MUCH stronger than my current [Mist Spear +2], but... I don’t really feel like switching weapons," she admitted.
"That makes sense," Leon nodded.
Weapon preference wasn’t just about stats, it was about familiarity, comfort, and fighting style.
Switching to something completely different could actually make someone weaker despite the higher numbers.
Leon himself wouldn’t switch away from his sword either, even if something technically stronger appeared.
And finally...
"You can take the skill book," Leon said with a small smile, "I already have more than enough skills for myself."
"Thank you~" Celeste beamed as she immediately infused the book with her mana.
Ding!
[You have learned the skill "Hellish Swing"!]
[Hellish Swing (Legendary): Focus the power of your flames at the tip of your weapon and swing it to deal a powerful fire-related attack that has x1.5 of your current strength.]
Even Leon raised his eyebrows slightly when he saw the description.
"Holy hell... that’s actually really strong," he admitted.
A strength multiplier combined with fire damage made it extremely dangerous, especially in Celeste’s hands.
Still, even knowing that, Leon didn’t regret giving it to her for even a second.
With everything sorted, Leon stored the remaining items in his [Storage Space], and the two of them finally began moving forward again.
Surprisingly, for the next few minutes, they didn’t encounter a single monster, which felt almost strange considering how chaotic things had been just moments ago.
"I think that [Hellish Hobgoblin] might have gathered almost every monster in the area," Celeste said as she looked around, "that’s probably why there were so many at once."
"Makes sense," Leon nodded, "which means... it’s time to find Emilia and finish this."

He opened his [World Map] once more and began following the direction of Emilia’s position, moving steadily through the scorched forest as the environment grew hotter the closer they got to the center of the island.
And eventually...
"Emilia!" Celeste called out as she waved and ran forward.
The elf stood ahead, two corpses lying near her feet, clearly showing that she had just finished dealing with a couple of enemies on her own.
"Hey~" Emilia smiled as she looked at them, "I figured you’d find us using your [World Map]."
"Yeah," Leon replied as he stepped forward, his gaze slowly lifting toward the massive volcano rising in the distance, its presence dominating the entire island.
"But now that we’re all together again..." His eyes narrowed slightly as a faint grin appeared on his face, "It’s time to get this over with."

It was better to secure guaranteed power than chase something uncertain.
The [Enhancement Frenzy Liquid (Ancient)] he had could have secured his chances, but even then, Leon chose not to use it.
He knew there would be far better situations in the future where using such a rare item would bring even greater benefits.
So instead, he simply handed the scrolls over and let Celeste make use of them.
Without wasting another second, Celeste immediately poured her mana into both scrolls, her expression turning serious as she focused, and almost instantly...
Ding!
Ding!
[Congratulations, you have learned the S-Level Sub-Talent: "Ultimate Flame Control"]
[You have evolved "Strength Enhancement (D-Level)" to "Super Strength Enhancement (B-Level)"]
The change was immediate.
Celeste’s body trembled slightly as a surge of power flowed through her.
Her flames reacted to the new sub-talent as if they had been given a new level of life, becoming sharper, hotter, and far more controlled than before.
While at the same time, her physical strength increased significantly thanks to the evolution of her strength-based sub-talent.
Since most of her attacks were already centered around fire, this upgrade didn’t just improve her slightly, it multiplied her effectiveness to a completely different level.
Her [Combat Power] rose rapidly, climbing to nearly 460,000 in just a few seconds.
Celeste slowly looked down at her hands as faint flames danced around her fingers, her eyes shining with excitement as she felt the difference.
"Wow..." she said quietly, clearly amazed, "I don’t think I could have ever reached this level by myself."
Her flames were no longer just powerful, they were refined, controlled, and far more efficient, allowing her to produce stronger effects.
Leon watched her reaction with a small smile.
"Good," he said simply, "but that’s still nothing compared to what we need to reach."
Hearing that, Celeste nodded without hesitation.
She already understood that Leon’s goals were far beyond just surviving in this domain, he was aiming for something much bigger, and she had no intention of falling behind.
Leon then turned his attention back to the rest of the items scattered on the ground, his expression shifting slightly as he prepared to go through the next step.
Without hesitation, he began consuming the essences one after another.
Nom!
Ding!
Nom!
Ding!
The notifications quickly followed.
[+290 Agility, +300 Spirit, +700 Strength]
"Nice," Leon nodded, clearly satisfied with the results.
Still, he didn’t keep everything for himself.
He deliberately set aside ten [Pyroman Ape Essences] and nine [Fire Hobgoblin Essences], knowing exactly who they were meant for.
He handed all of the [Fire Hobgoblin Essences] to Celeste, since they provided a direct boost to strength, something that perfectly matched her combat style with the spear.
While the remaining essences were reserved for Emilia, who would benefit from them once they regrouped.
After that, Leon moved on to the [Pyroman Ape Fur x40 (Rare)] items, preparing to enhance them through fusion, his focus returning as he carefully went through the process step by step.
The fusions took some time, but by the end of it, the results were more than worth it.
Fwoosh!
(Max) [Pyroman Ape Fur +4 (Rare): +2,800 Constitution, +1,700 Spirit.
High resistance to fire-related attacks.]
Leon had successfully pushed three of them to the maximum level.
Without hesitation, he equipped the first one around his own neck, feeling the immediate increase in durability and resistance as the fur settled comfortably.
Then he handed the second one to Celeste, who accepted it with a smile, while the third was, once again, reserved for Emilia.
"Sorting through all of this actually takes longer than the fight itself," Celeste said with a small laugh as she adjusted the fur around her neck.
"Yeah," Leon replied with a nod, "but in the end, it’s always worth it, since it makes us stronger."
At this point, only two major items remained.
The [Hell Bat (Legendary)] and the [Skill Book: Hellish Swing (Legendary)].
Celeste picked up the weapon and examined it for a moment, clearly impressed by its stats, but after a few seconds, she shook her head slightly.
"It’s definitely MUCH stronger than my current [Mist Spear +2], but...
I don’t really feel like switching weapons," she admitted.
"That makes sense," Leon nodded.
Weapon preference wasn’t just about stats, it was about familiarity, comfort, and fighting style.
Switching to something completely different could actually make someone weaker despite the higher numbers.
Leon himself wouldn’t switch away from his sword either, even if something technically stronger appeared.
And finally...
"You can take the skill book," Leon said with a small smile, "I already have more than enough skills for myself."
"Thank you~" Celeste beamed as she immediately infused the book with her mana.
Ding!
[You have learned the skill "Hellish Swing"!]
[Hellish Swing (Legendary): Focus the power of your flames at the tip of your weapon and swing it to deal a powerful fire-related attack that has x1.5 of your current strength.]
Even Leon raised his eyebrows slightly when he saw the description.
"Holy hell... that’s actually really strong," he admitted.
A strength multiplier combined with fire damage made it extremely dangerous, especially in Celeste’s hands.
Still, even knowing that, Leon didn’t regret giving it to her for even a second.
With everything sorted, Leon stored the remaining items in his [Storage Space], and the two of them finally began moving forward again.
Surprisingly, for the next few minutes, they didn’t encounter a single monster, which felt almost strange considering how chaotic things had been just moments ago.
"I think that [Hellish Hobgoblin] might have gathered almost every monster in the area," Celeste said as she looked around, "that’s probably why there were so many at once."
"Makes sense," Leon nodded, "which means... it’s time to find Emilia and finish this."

He opened his [World Map] once more and began following the direction of Emilia’s position, moving steadily through the scorched forest as the environment grew hotter the closer they got to the center of the island.
And eventually...
"Emilia!" Celeste called out as she waved and ran forward.
The elf stood ahead, two corpses lying near her feet, clearly showing that she had just finished dealing with a couple of enemies on her own.
"Hey~" Emilia smiled as she looked at them, "I figured you’d find us using your [World Map]."
"Yeah," Leon replied as he stepped forward, his gaze slowly lifting toward the massive volcano rising in the distance, its presence dominating the entire island.
"But now that we’re all together again..." His eyes narrowed slightly as a faint grin appeared on his face, "It’s time to get this over with."

chapters.title: Chapter 197: What The Hell is The Eternal Battlefield?!
paragraphs: After regrouping with Emilia, the trio didn’t waste any more time standing around.
At this point there was only one clear objective left in the entire [Hellish Beach] realm, and that was the massive volcano standing at the very center of the island.

Its presence dominated everything around it as thick smoke rose into the sky and a constant red glow pulsed from within, making it obvious that whatever awaited them there would be far more dangerous than anything they had faced so far.
Without hesitation, Leon took the lead and began moving forward at a steady pace, with Celeste and Emilia following closely behind him.

All three of them fully aware that there was no reason to delay any longer, especially now that they had finished gathering resources, leveling up, and strengthening themselves to the best of their current ability.
There were no more distractions. Only the final boss remained.

As they moved through the scorched forest and gradually approached the inner area of the island, the ground beneath their feet became more and more cracked, with faint streams of heat rising from below.
The air itself grew heavier and hotter with every step they took, making it clear that they were getting closer to the heart of the volcano.
"There’s really nothing left to do now," Emilia said as she kept pace with Leon, her tone calm but focused, "I already reached level 70 too, so we’re all pretty close."
That was true, because all three of them were now approaching level 75, which meant they were nearing the next major milestone in their progression.
Only a few more levels remained.
And after that... They would be able to enter the final divine temple.

"Final divine temple?" Celeste suddenly asked, tilting her head slightly as she ran alongside them, clearly confused by something, "But... there’s one at level 75, and then another one at level 100, right?"
For a brief moment, Leon didn’t answer.
Then, his expression shifted slightly, becoming colder as his gaze remained fixed ahead.
"No," he said calmly, his voice steady but serious, "There’s no divine temple at level 100."
That answer immediately caught both Celeste and Emilia off guard.
Celeste frowned slightly, clearly trying to process that information.
"That’s... strange," she said slowly, "Then how do you even reach the [Eternal Domain]? It can’t just be instant, right?"
Leon remained silent for a second, as if recalling something. Then he spoke again.
"The most dangerous place we’ll ever face before reaching the [Eternal Domain]," he said, his tone carrying a weight that made both girls instinctively tense up, "the [Eternal Battlefield]."

The moment those words left his mouth, a chill ran down both Celeste’s and Emilia’s spines, because even without knowing the details, the name alone carried a sense of danger that was impossible to ignore.
"The [Eternal Battlefield]..." Emilia repeated quietly, her eyes widening slightly, "that sounds... insane."
"It is," Leon replied without hesitation as they continued moving forward, "and that’s not even the worst part.
He paused briefly before continuing.

"Most people don’t even choose to step into the [Eternal Domain] in the first place, but even for those who do... something stands in their way, making sure that only the absolute strongest can move forward."
Celeste swallowed lightly as she listened.
"So we’re going to have to go through that eventually?" she asked.
Leon nodded, "Yes," he said simply, "but not now."
His gaze remained calm, but there was a clear determination behind it, "We’ll prepare for it properly."
Unlike the others, Leon had already experienced the [Eternal Battlefield] once in his previous life.
And even though there was no guarantee that things would be exactly the same this time, he still had a massive advantage in terms of knowledge.
He knew what kind of strength was required, what kind of threats existed there, and how unforgiving it could be for anyone who entered unprepared.
Of course, there was no guarantee his assessment in his past life would be the same in this one, in fact, Leon very much doubted so.
With his luck and the fact he was a [Celestial], he’d probably the most difficult assessment possible.
But as of right now... They weren’t even close to ready.
Even at their current [Combat Power], stepping into a place like that would be nothing short of suicide.
But that didn’t matter yet. There was still time.
And before they could even think about that, they needed to finish what they had started here.
"Here, by the way," Leon suddenly said as he reached into his [Storage Space] and pulled out a scroll before tossing it toward Emilia without slowing down, "this should help you."
Emilia caught it mid-run and glanced down at it.
The moment she saw what it was, her entire expression froze.
"C-Can I really take this?" she asked, clearly surprised, her voice slightly hesitant, "I mean... this is an S-Level sub-talent..."
"Haha," Celeste laughed lightly from the side, "I said the exact same thing earlier, it’s kind of funny hearing someone else react like that."
Emilia blinked once, then looked at Celeste, quickly realizing what that meant.
"You got one too?" she asked.
Celeste nodded with a grin.
And just like that, Emilia didn’t hesitate anymore.
She immediately poured her mana into the scroll.
Ding!
[Congratulations, you have learned the S-Level Sub-Talent: "Ultimate Flame Control"]
Almost instantly, she felt the difference. Her body relaxed slightly as the intense heat around them seemed far less oppressive than before.
Her resistance to fire increased dramatically as her control over flame-based energy improved.
"Oh wow..." Emilia said as she looked around, clearly surprised, "I don’t feel the heat as much anymore... I think I’m almost immune to fire at this point."
"Not completely," Leon corrected her calmly, "so don’t get careless."
Still, even with that limitation, Emilia was now ridiculously well-suited for this environment.
With her already high [Constitution] combined with her new resistance, it was safe to say that most of the threats in this realm simply couldn’t harm her anymore, no matter how long they tried.
As for Celeste... She had grown much stronger as well, but even then, she remained the weakest among the three.
Leon glanced at her briefly, his thoughts shifting.
’Those [Embers] are really annoying...’ he thought, his eyes narrowing slightly, ’her talent doesn’t even give any clear direction at all.’
At this point, they were close to reaching level 75, which meant they were nearing another major assessment.
And yet Celeste’s talent hadn’t provided a single clear hint about how to obtain additional [Embers], which were clearly the key to her growth.
She still only had the [Phoenix Ember]. And nothing else.
For something that was supposedly so important, the lack of guidance was... unusual.
Even in Leon’s previous life, he had never encountered a talent quite like hers.
It was complex. Unclear. And potentially extremely powerful.
If obtaining an [Ember] was this difficult... Then the reward had to be worth it.
Leon didn’t know whether that was a good thing or a bad thing yet.
But for now, there was nothing they could do about it.

Without saying anything, Leon handed the remaining essences to Emilia, along with the last [Pyroman Ape Fur +4 (Rare)], making sure that everyone in the group was properly equipped and strengthened before the final fight.
"Thanks," Emilia said with a smile as she quickly consumed the essences and equipped the fur, her stats increasing further.
And just like that... They were ready.

chapters.title: Chapter 198: Crossing The Molten River, Entering the Volcano
paragraphs: As they continued moving forward, the environment became increasingly hostile, not because of monsters this time, but because of the sheer heat radiating from the volcano, which intensified with every step they took.
The air felt heavy. The ground was unstable. And lava could be seen flowing in the distance, slowly spreading across the area.
Interestingly, there were no monsters left around them.
It seemed that even the creatures of this realm avoided getting too close to the volcano itself, as the extreme conditions made it dangerous even for them.
And so eventually... They arrived.
"Here it is," Leon said with a faint grin as they stopped in front of the massive volcano.
At its base was a large cave-like entrance, dark and ominous, clearly leading deeper into the structure where the final boss awaited them.
This was it. The path to the [Volcano Crab King].
Without hesitation, the three of them stepped forward,
The environment became even more intense as they approached the entrance, with molten lava flowing through cracks in the ground.
Leon looked at the two girls beside him, a small grin forming on his face.
"Just a little more," he said, his voice calm but filled with anticipation, "let’s finish this."
"Yay~" Celeste replied with a tired but excited smile, "I seriously hate this realm."
"It wasn’t that bad," Emilia shrugged lightly, though she smiled as well, "but yeah... let’s go."
As they advanced toward the entrance, the heat became unbearable, to the point where the very air seemed to burn their lungs with each breath.
And eventually, they were faced with a massive obstacle that made it clear why most players never even reached this part of the [Hellish Beach].
A river of magma stretched across their path, wide and violently flowing, bubbling and bursting with heat so intense that even standing near it felt dangerous.
For a brief moment, the three of them stopped. Then Leon stepped forward.
"I’ll be fine," he said calmly, glancing back at the two of them, "What about you?"
And without waiting for an answer—
Fwoosh!
Leon stepped directly into the river of lava.
The moment his body made contact, the burning sensation hit him instantly, spreading across his skin like a wave of heat that tried to overwhelm his senses.
But despite that, he didn’t stop moving forward, forcing his body to adapt as he pushed through it.
It hurt slightly, there was no denying that, but it wasn’t enough to kill him.

That was entirely thanks to [Master of Elements], which granted him resistance comparable to an SS-Level fire affinity, allowing him to endure something that would instantly melt most players without even leaving behind a trace.
Emilia watched him for a second, then shrugged lightly, "I guess I’ll do the same."
And just like that, she stepped into the magma as well.
Unlike Leon, her reaction was even calmer, as if the lava didn’t bother her nearly as much.
Her new S-Level sub-talent combined with her absurd [Constitution] multiplier made her body incredibly durable, to the point where even this kind of environment couldn’t even damage her properly.
She didn’t rush either, simply walking through the molten river with steady steps.
Meanwhile, Celeste stood there, staring at the two of them in disbelief.
She watched as both Leon and Emilia casually moved through lava like it was just another inconvenience.
"I don’t think I can do that..." she muttered, scratching her head.
It wasn’t that she couldn’t survive it for a short time, but the idea of willingly stepping into lava like that didn’t sit well with her at all.
Still, that didn’t mean she didn’t have her own way of crossing. She exhaled slightly, then focused.
Phoenix Wings!
In an instant, blazing wings erupted from her back, spreading wide with a majestic presence that lit up the area around her.
With a few powerful flaps, Celeste took off, soaring above the river of magma with ease, completely avoiding the danger below.
Thump!
She landed smoothly on the other side, turning back just in time to see Leon and Emilia still making their way through.
"Oh."
After about a minute, Leon finally stepped out of the magma, his armor slightly scorched but still intact, followed shortly by Emilia.
"I’m never doing this again," Leon said with a grim expression, clearly not enjoying the experience despite surviving it.
Thankfully, he had stored most of his equipment in his [Storage Space] beforehand, leaving only what was necessary, which prevented him from losing anything important.
Emilia, however...
"Wait, what?"
As she stepped out of the lava, the situation became very clear very quickly.
Almost all of her clothes had been completely burned away.
"Damn..." Leon muttered as he immediately turned around, making sure not to look.
Emilia froze for a split second before her face turned bright red, her mind finally catching up with what had just happened.
Without wasting any time, she hurriedly opened her [Storage Space], fumbling slightly as she searched for something to wear.
Thankfully, she found a replacement.
Fwoosh!
A [Moon Sect Devout Robe +5] appeared around her body, covering her instantly.
"I’m done..." Emilia said after a moment, trying to calm herself down, though the redness on her face didn’t fade completely.
Leon waited a few seconds before turning back, "Trying to swim through lava with a robe was..."
"...Stupid, I know," Emilia finished with a small sigh, though she couldn’t help but let out a slight laugh afterward, "I really should have thought that through."
She had lost her previous robe, and the new one wasn’t nearly as strong, but at least she wasn’t standing there with nothing anymore.
"We’ll get you something better later," Leon said calmly, not making a big deal out of it as he turned his attention forward, "For now... let’s keep moving."
The two girls nodded, and together, the three of them stepped into the cave-like entrance of the massive volcano.
The moment they entered, the environment changed again.
They found themselves in a massive hall, the walls made of dark stone covered in glowing crimson cracks, with streams of lava dripping down from above.
The heat inside was even worse than outside, pressing against their bodies constantly, but none of them hesitated.
They walked forward. And at the end of the hall—
Ding!
[You have entered the "Hellish Volcano’s Heart"]

Fwoosh!
A [Moon Sect Devout Robe +5] appeared around her body, covering her instantly.
"I’m done..." Emilia said after a moment, trying to calm herself down, though the redness on her face didn’t fade completely.
Leon waited a few seconds before turning back, "Trying to swim through lava with a robe was..."
"...Stupid, I know," Emilia finished with a small sigh, though she couldn’t help but let out a slight laugh afterward, "I really should have thought that through."
She had lost her previous robe, and the new one wasn’t nearly as strong, but at least she wasn’t standing there with nothing anymore.
"We’ll get you something better later," Leon said calmly, not making a big deal out of it as he turned his attention forward, "For now... let’s keep moving."
The two girls nodded, and together, the three of them stepped into the cave-like entrance of the massive volcano.
The moment they entered, the environment changed again.
They found themselves in a massive hall, the walls made of dark stone covered in glowing crimson cracks, with streams of lava dripping down from above.
The heat inside was even worse than outside, pressing against their bodies constantly, but none of them hesitated.
They walked forward.
And at the end of the hall—
Ding!
[You have entered the "Hellish Volcano’s Heart"]

chapters.title: Chapter 199: The Volcano Crab King [1]
paragraphs: Leon, Celeste and Emilia stepped into an enormous chamber located at the very core of the volcano.
Below them, lava surged and exploded, flowing violently in every direction, while in front of them stood a massive stone platform surrounded by molten rivers.
It didn’t take long to understand what this place was.
"This feels... imposing," Celeste said, her voice slightly quieter than usual as she looked around, "We’re really going to fight here?"
"No other choice," Leon replied with a small shrug, his expression calm as always, "We just have to be stronger."
They walked forward until they reached the center of the platform.
And the moment they did—
RUMBLE!
The entire chamber shook violently as the path behind them collapsed, sealing the entrance completely.
There was no turning back now. Leon didn’t react much, his gaze already shifting around the arena.
Vision Enhancement!
His eyes sharpened instantly, the world becoming clearer and more detailed as he scanned every corner, every crack, every possible movement.
But nothing happened. Seconds passed. Then a minute. Then two.
His skill faded, and still, nothing appeared.
"Are we sure the [Volcano Crab King] is here?" Celeste asked, her grip tightening slightly on her spear.
"Why would there be an arena like this, and why would our exit be sealed if not for it?" Emilia replied, her eyes moving constantly as she stayed on guard.
"Yeah... you’re right," Celeste nodded.
All three of them remained ready.
Leon held both his sword and staff, prepared to switch between close combat and spells at any moment.
Emilia raised her scepter as well, ready to either support or attack depending on the situation.
And Celeste spun her spear lightly, flames dancing along its edge as she prepared to use her newly acquired [Hellish Swing].
Time passed slowly. The only sound was the constant movement of lava beneath them.
Then finally—
"Alright," Celeste said, exhaling slightly as she stepped forward, "If it’s hiding... then let’s force it out."
She spun her spear once more, gathering flames around it before driving it straight into the ground.
For a moment, nothing happened.
But then—
"ARGH...!"
Emilia suddenly clutched her head, her body trembling slightly as a sharp pain hit her.
Leon immediately rushed to her side, "Are you okay?!"
It was the first time he had seen her react like this.
For a few seconds, Emilia struggled to even speak, her breathing uneven, as if something was pressing down on her mind.
Then suddenly, she looked down.
"IT’S COMING FROM BELOW!"
The moment those words left her mouth, both Leon and Celeste snapped their attention to the ground beneath them.
And in the next instant—
BOOOOOOM!
The platform beneath their feet exploded upward.

Two massive pincers burst out from below like living weapons, tearing through the stone as if it were nothing, one of them lunging directly toward Emilia while the other targeted Leon, who had been standing right next to her only a moment ago.

They moved with terrifying speed, far faster than something of that size should have been able to, closing the distance in an instant as they snapped forward with the clear intent of cutting both of them cleanly in half.
Leon reacted almost purely on instinct.
Darkness Barrier!

A dark shield formed around his body in a split second, buying him just enough time to brace himself against what was coming, but even then, he could feel the pressure of the incoming attack before it even connected.
Snap!
The pincer slammed shut around him, crushing against the barrier with overwhelming force, and in less than a second, the shield shattered like glass under pressure.
’Holy hell...’ Leon’s eyes widened as he felt the impact travel through his body, ’That thing’s grip is way too strong.’
Even though the barrier had been destroyed instantly, it had still done its job.
That single moment of resistance gave Leon just enough time to push himself backward, forcing his body away from the pincer’s deadly range before it could close completely around him.
He slid across the ground, regaining his footing as his eyes immediately darted back toward Emilia.
And what he saw made his expression tighten. She hadn’t moved.
Emilia had been the first to sense the danger, the one who warned them, but the sudden headache that hit her had slowed her reaction just enough to make the difference.
SNAP!
The second pincer closed around her body completely, the sound echoing through the chamber as it crushed down with terrifying force, strong enough to kill almost any player instantly.
Even Leon knew that if he had been caught directly without any form of defense, he wouldn’t have survived that kind of attack.
The sheer raw power behind that strike was far beyond what most players at their level could handle.
And yet, Leon didn’t rush forward immediately. Instead, his eyes narrowed slightly.
The pincer tightened, the massive claw applying more and more pressure, clearly trying to crush Emilia completely.
But nothing happened. No sign of damage.
"I think... I’m fine," Emilia muttered, her voice strained as she remained completely immobilized inside the claw, unable to move but clearly still alive.
Leon blinked once. Then he let out a short chuckle.
"Well damn... I guess your [Constitution] really is built different."
Even something like that, an attack that should have killed instantly, wasn’t enough to break through her absurd durability.
Still, that didn’t mean the situation was safe.
Being trapped like that in the middle of a boss fight was the last thing they needed.
And before either Leon or Celeste could react to free her—
BOOM!
The ground shattered even further as the rest of the creature emerged from below.

The [Volcano Crab King] rose from beneath the platform, its massive body tearing through the stone as if it had never been there in the first place, its presence alone making the entire chamber feel smaller.

The creature was colossal. When fully extended, it stood at nearly four meters tall, its body covered in thick crimson armor that looked more like molten rock than actual shell, with glowing cracks of lava running across its surface like veins.
Its eyes moved slowly, scanning the area with an eerie awareness, locking onto the three players as if analyzing them one by one.
Clack! Clack!
Its massive claws opened and closed repeatedly, the one holding Emilia tightening slightly each time as if trying to crush her again, yet no matter how much force it applied, she still didn’t break.
"...?" The creature seemed confused.
For a brief moment, it simply stared at her, as if trying to understand why something so small wasn’t being crushed like everything else it had ever grabbed.
Normally, it would have already killed one or two intruders the moment it appeared.
But this time... nothing. Emilia was still there. Still alive. That alone seemed to irritate it.
I wanted to release more privilege at once but I had a lot of things going on IRL, my bad guys, I’ll try to upload more soon!

chapters.title: Chapter 200: The Volcano Crab King [2]
paragraphs: SKREEEEEE!

The [Volcano Crab King] let out a massive screetch that echoed through the entire chamber, shaking the walls as small chunks of rock fell from above, the lava below surging even more violently in response to its presence.
Leon tightened his grip on both his sword and staff, his expression sharpening as he took a step forward, positioning himself slightly ahead of Celeste.
"Alright," he said calmly, his eyes locked onto the massive boss, "We need to free Emilia first."
Celeste nodded immediately, her grip on her spear tightening, "Got it!"
Even though the situation looked bad at first glance, neither of them panicked.
Emilia was still alive. And as long as she was alive, they still had full control over the fight.
Leon’s mind was already moving quickly, analyzing the boss, its movements, its reactions, and most importantly... the strength of its claws.
If those pincers could crush something like his barrier instantly, then taking a direct hit would be a mistake he couldn’t afford to make again.
At the same time, he also noted something else. The boss was focusing too much on Emilia.
It kept trying to crush her, almost obsessively, as if it couldn’t accept the fact that she was still alive.
Which meant one thing: it wasn’t paying full attention to them. A small grin appeared on Leon’s face.
"Celeste," he said quietly, "we’re going to take advantage of that."
She didn’t even ask what he meant.
She simply nodded again, flames rising higher around her spear as her flames flickered slightly behind her.

Meanwhile, the [Volcano Crab King] tightened its grip once more, its claw creaking under its own force as it tried again and again to crush Emilia, completely unaware that the real danger was standing right in front of it.
"Go all out," Leon shouted toward Celeste, his voice steady but loud enough to cut through the noise of the roaring volcano, "Emilia can’t be harmed by our attacks anyway!"
Celeste didn’t hesitate for even a second after hearing that.
Since Emilia had already shared her status panel with her earlier, Celeste knew exactly what Leon meant, and more importantly, she understood why he was saying it with such confidence.
Between Emilia’s [Support Saint] and [Magic Saint] titles, her defenses weren’t just high, they were absurd to the point where normal attacks, even powerful ones, would struggle to harm her at all.
That meant something extremely important in a fight like this: they didn’t need to hold back.
Even if their attacks hit Emilia while trying to free her, the chances of actually injuring her were incredibly low.
Leon knew that if he poured a massive amount of mana into one of his strongest attacks, or if he used something like [Oblivion Meteor], then yes, he could probably hurt her.
But he had no intention of doing anything like that here. So as far as this battle was concerned... Emilia was safe.
"Argh...!"
Meanwhile, Emilia let out a strained sound as the [Volcano Crab King] began shaking her violently, clearly growing frustrated that its crushing grip wasn’t doing anything to her.
Its massive claw tightened again and again, the pressure strong enough to shatter boulders into dust, yet her body refused to break.
From the creature’s perspective, this made no sense.
It had crushed countless enemies before. Even something like the [Hellish Hobgoblin] would have been reduced to nothing in a single squeeze.
And yet this small elf... Was still alive. Still resisting.
"Kerrkrk!"
The crab king let out a strange, irritated noise, its eyes twitching slightly as it tried to understand what was happening.
But Leon didn’t waste time watching.
While the boss was fully distracted with Emilia, he spun his staff lightly in his hand and focused.
Appraisal!
[Volcano Crab King (Realm Boss)]
[Level: 75]
[Talent: Mega Strength Enhancement (A-Level), Absolute Flame Control (A-Level)]
[Combat Power: 750,000]
[Details: A king that protects this volcano and island from anyone approaching it, has complete control over the volcano.]
"Damn..." Leon muttered under his breath as he read through the panel.
The numbers alone were enough to make most players hesitate.
Its [Combat Power] was on the same level as the [Will of Nature], but Leon already knew that didn’t tell the whole story.
If anything, this opponent might be even more troublesome.
The [Will of Nature] relied on overwhelming regeneration and its vines, but this thing... This thing controlled fire.
And in a place like this, inside a volcano, that made it far more dangerous.
Leon’s eyes narrowed slightly as he thought about his passive.
Based on everything he had experienced so far, he could already tell that [Celestial’s Might] probably wouldn’t activate here.
It had triggered against the [Will of Nature] because that fight had been overwhelmingly one-sided at first.
But this time... The gap wasn’t big enough. This would be a straight fight. And Leon was perfectly fine with that.
Without wasting any more time, he raised his staff.
Torrent of Lightning!

The air around the chamber crackled instantly as dozens of lightning strikes formed above, illuminating the entire arena with flashes of white and blue before crashing down toward the [Volcano Crab King].
Zap! Zap! Zap!
Each bolt struck directly against the boss’s massive shell, exploding on impact and sending sparks flying in every direction.
And yet... The creature didn’t react. Not even a flinch.
"Oh wow..." Leon blinked once, genuinely surprised, "I guess aiming from above isn’t the move."
He glanced briefly toward Celeste, "It’s probably way too sturdy on top, don’t waste your attacks there."
She nodded, already adjusting her stance as she analyzed the boss as well.
Still, Leon wasn’t done testing.
Powerful Fireball!
A blazing sphere of fire formed at the tip of his staff before shooting forward and slamming directly into the crab king’s body.
BOOM!
The explosion spread across its shell, flames bursting outward...
But once again, nothing. The boss didn’t even seem to notice.
"...Damn," Leon muttered, his expression tightening slightly.
Its entire focus was still on Emilia, completely ignoring the damage he was trying to deal.
But even if it ignored him... That didn’t mean it would let them act freely forever.
SKREEEEEE!
The [Volcano Crab King] suddenly let out a sharp, piercing screech that echoed through the chamber, making the ground tremble once more.
This time, though, something actually changed.
